rows.text: Yo, it's you! You're interested in the supernatural, right?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: But before you watch it, I gotta ask you a question... do you believe in ghosts?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I believe!
Vids or it didn't happen... and no clickbait.
My beliefs aside, your messages...
I knew it! Curious cats like us usually have a better sixth sense — it's easier for us to perceive the unseen...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Hehe, I think you're in for a surprise...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: This video is gonna prove that the Xianzhou is full of supernatural phenomena.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Uhh, that was me copying video titles from the hottest streamers on the Luofu... I heard they help attract more viewers.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Enough chit-chat — look! This is the weird stuff that happened yesterday when I was streaming in Fyxestroll Garden!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Me and my bestie got kicked out of the garden straight after... but did you see the key moment?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: The "ghosts" were cheap special effects?
Why is it in third-person perspective at the end?
The comments all look like bots wrote them...
What!? No! There was a freezing chill, not to mention the way they drifted through the air... They were legit ghosts! Anyway, the key point was...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Ugh, it's called editing? I edited it! That way I can show what happened before and after. Anyway, the key moment was...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Why are you so focused on all the wrong things?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: It wasn't the Realm-Keeping Commission or the Cloud Knights that came to deal with it. It was the judges from the Ten-Lords Commission!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Judges from the Ten-Lords Commission? That's crazy!
What's... the Ten-Lords Commission?
That's what I'm saying! At first, Sushang didn't believe that Fyxestroll Garden was haunted. But after the judges showed up...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: You've been on the Xianzhou for this long and you've never heard of the Ten-Lords Commission?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: They're the most mysterious organization on the Xianzhou! Their investigators always pop up out of nowhere, then disappear without a trace. If they show up, you know something serious is going down!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: In other words, something BIG must have happened in Fyxestroll Garden for them to show up.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: They went to Fyxestroll Garden to catch ghosts...
Maybe it was just a false alarm?
Exactly! Now do you believe that my content isn't clickbait?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Possibly... but the judges kicked me and Sushang out of there straight away. It looked like they were setting something up in the garden before we left.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: There has to be a conspiracy... Uh, I mean — ghosts!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Actually, do you have some free time? Do you wanna explore Fyxestroll Garden together, just the two of us? I guarantee you we're gonna reveal the truth this time.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Let's face the ghosts together!
You're going despite the risk?
I'm a little scared. Let me think it over...
Hee-hee, I knew it! This is what people like us live for. Let's go!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: High risk, high reward, high view count. As we grow up, our curiosity for the unknown gradually fades... I'm not gonna let myself become a boring grown-up.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Why are the ghosts haunting the garden? A lingering grudge, perhaps... or maybe they're an omen of some impending disaster? Aren't you curious?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Sure.
No.
Don't be scared. When the time comes, just hide behind me.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I get it — you're scared. I'm scared too. I'm sure you'll find your courage sooner or later. I'll be here waiting for you when you do!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I understand — I'm scared too! I'm sure you'll find your courage sooner or later. I'll be here waiting for you when you do!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Yo, how's that super strong sixth sense of yours?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wanna explore Fyxestroll Garden with me? I KNOW we're gonna get to the truth this time.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Let's face the ghosts together!
I'm a little scared. Let me think it over...
Hee-hee, I knew it! This is what people like us live for. Let's go!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: What? What's there to think about? I get it. I'll be waiting for you here when you're ready!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wow, I didn't know you were so strong, bro! But these are Luofu officials... if we're interrogated, we need to get our story straight...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We could say evil spirits possessed the spiritfarers...
We could say that evil spirits possessed us...
Perhaps we were never here?
Perfect! Let's just say it was self-defense. We had no choice.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Makes sense. We went crazy and couldn't control ourselves... I like the way you think.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Whoa! Nice! There were no witnesses, so this never happened, alright?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Let's keep going.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Halt!
rows.speaker: Wraith Warden

rows.text: ...Wh—What's up guys, hear me out!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: State your name and your business! Arrest them immediately!
rows.speaker: Wraith Warden

rows.text: What a strange girl. Here to film ghosts, yet terrified when she lays eyes on one...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Deep breaths, Little Gui, deep breaths...! Ahem, c—can I have a small chat with this... "Mr. Tail?"
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I said scram. I have no time to talk nonsense with you.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: What a rude ghost!
Let's go. He doesn't want to talk to us.
I told you, I'm not a ghost! If I have to repeat myself again I'll be eating every one of you!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Please don't be afraid, he's only kidding. Mr. Tail is a vegetarian.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Finally, someone with common sense.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: N—No way! This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to get something for my vids!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Your Honor, if I may ask, what exactly is this... fire thing? How can we prevent it from hurting people? ...And why is a judge carrying one around with her...?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I believe we're done here. We have important matters to attend to. Huohuo, please see them off.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Y—Yes, ma'am.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Sister, don't be angry. Most of your time is spent in the field — you're not accustomed to dealing with others. Leave this to me. If I explain the reasoning, they will leave.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: As things stand, the situation in Fyxestroll Garden is sure to keep drawing attention. If we forcibly dismiss these two today, their curiosity will remain — who knows what might happen if they decide to come back. They might not be lucky enough to run into us next time.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: As I said, sister, I will handle this.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I assume the two of you heard about the damage done to the Artisanship Commission's Creation Furnace? The "heliobi" sealed within escaped and have been haunting this place. The Ten-Lords Commission has orders to capture them. I am strongly advising you to leave — for your own safety.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: If you have any questions, raise them now — I will do my best to satisfy your curiosity. But I hope you will keep any information you hear in strict confidence... and then leave Fyxestroll Garden — never to return.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Th—That's very reasonable, Your Honor! Thank you. I promise we'll leave after asking our questions.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: As a clerk at the Hall of Karma, my knowledge on these matters is somewhat limited, but I will try my best to satisfy your curiosity. Please proceed.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: What exactly are heliobi?
Are heliobi dangerous?
I don't have any other questions.
According to the Divination Commission's classification, they are energy parasites from the cosmos itself. They are "Starfire Essence" that materialize in the form of strange fire.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Metaphorically speaking, they are like moths to a flame... but that flame is the thoughts of sentient beings.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yes. They attach themselves to sentient beings, feeding off their host's experiences and emotions.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: A heliobus will slowly take root in its host's nervous system, using their deepest desires and weaknesses to create wild delusions. They manipulate their host like a chess piece. The host has no choice but to obey the heliobus, so we refer to it as "possession."
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: By that point, the host is no longer who they once were, but a heliobus both similar to and completely different from their past self. The host's body will soon be exhausted by the heliobus — like burnt firewood.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: So, Tail is dangerous, too?
Dangerous!? You don't know the half of it! The other heliobi are nothing compared to me!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tail... was subdued and sealed in my tail by Madam Hanya. He won't harm others.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Regrettably, heliobi are not flesh-and-blood, and so they are difficult to destroy. Before the restoration of the Creation Furnace, the Ten-Lords Commission plans to set up an "Evil Binding Matrix" in this abandoned garden to imprison these abominations.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: As you can see, the Evil Binding Matrix has not yet been completed, and not all the escaped heliobi have been recovered. This area is still very dangerous. I will ask Judge Huohuo to escort you out of the garden.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: "Not all the escaped heliobi have been recovered..." So that means the other supernatural stuff that's been happening on the Luofu might be related? Your Honor! I have loads of info sources! Maybe I can help you!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Unnecessary. Those not involved should leave now. Go.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Um... Excuse me... We should go.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ghosts? Heliobi? Possession...? That was a big info dump, my brain is still loading...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...It all sounds more like an urban myth than a ghost story. "Energy parasite" sounds more cool than scary... don't you think?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Myths are born out of ignorance.
Ghosts can't exist without mystery.
Yeah, I guess so... I still feel like my audience will see them as ghosts, to be honest.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Mm, I never thought about it like that. Nice take!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: My audience likes getting to the bottom of mysteries, secrets, and conspiracies... We streamers have to cater to that, you know?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: *sigh* I've got loads more questions, but my curiosity is satisfied for now. We better leave before the judges decide to arrest us.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...I'm gonna see if I can get a video of Mr. Tail on the way back — I've already got the title: "Demonic Fire Suddenly Appears in Fyxestroll Garden! Innocent Foxian Girl Possessed!" What do you think? That'd get so many views...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Can you give me a hand?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: What are we gonna do with you...
Nope.
You'll be handed a few centuries of jail time if you irritate the judges.
Wow! That's a yes, right...?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Okay, fine! No need to be so blunt about it.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Mm, true, but I'd probably only do a few decades, hehe.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Let's go.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Excuse me, can we go now?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Is Tail coming too?
You look nervous...
Yes... he's trapped in my tail, so...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Bah — trapped for now... Sooner or later I'll find a way to make you break the seal...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You think I like spending time with you?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I—I'm just a bit scared about the heliobi reports... b—but I'll carry out my duties and escort you out of the garden. I should be able to do that, at least...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Tsk... If you can't then you better give up the day job and start peddling desserts...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hmph, i—if it weren't for you, I would've opened a dessert stall ages ago!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Shall we go?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Yes. Please lead the way.
I still have something to do.
Let's go.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Shall we go?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Yes, thank you.
I still have something to do.
Let's go.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It's a ghoooost!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wahhhh! Wh—Wh—What's happening?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: D—D—Don't be scared!
Is it the same kind of thing as Mr. Tail?
We're all good. Let's keep going.
I—I—I'm not scared! I just can't stop my legs shaking...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Tail, is it another heliobus?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It's nothing. You scaredy-cat, I didn't see a single thing.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Oh... I heard Miss Guinaifen yell, so I got scared...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Wait a minute... where did Miss Guinaifen go? Miss Guinaifen...!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...D—Did we lose her...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh no... W—We have to find Miss Guinaifen...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You should consider your own safety, first...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Is it me or is this place starting to feel weirder and weirder...? I'm scared... Can you stay close to me? I don't want to lose you, too...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The Wraith Wardens who guard the Locufox Forest entrance wanted to prevent you from leaving, but they held themselves back.

They must have realized that you and the bat in your hands have never feared any ghosts or spirits. Any form of hindrance would be a waste of time. No one can stop you — you have access to the Space Anchor, after all.
However, {RUBY_B#partner in crime}your new friend{RUBY_E#} Guinaifen is still waiting for you. You should listen to Xueyi and let Huohuo take you two out of here.
Are we... back in Fyxestroll Garden?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You have returned safely. It seems the Ten-Lords Commission is not down on our luck today.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Madam Xueyi, I'm so happy to see you're alright!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Did you encounter anything strange on your way here?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: The game's up, Cirrus.
Cirrus, get out of my body. Now.
I got possessed! Help me!
Hehehe, no wonder she's a judge. Very perceptive...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Huohuo informs Xueyi of what you have experienced so far...

I understand. This isn't the time to deal with Cirrus. Fyxestroll Garden has been dragged into a powerful illusion by an even mightier heliobus, and the spiritfarers who went to suppress it have lost contact with me.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Huohuo, if both Hanya and I are unable to suppress that demon, then you will have to defeat it.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Huh? I—I won't be able to do it! I'm not as powerful as you two... I always run and hide before a battle...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Do not underestimate yourself. A heliobus cannot possess a body that is already possessed by another heliobus — such is your absolute advantage as a judge.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I'm possessed too — do I also get an advantage?
Indeed. Even the weakest person has their strengths.
Correct. However, Huohuo has had many more years of training and is more experienced in fighting heliobi than you.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: That is why the Ten-Lords Commission is not down on our luck today. We're lucky that you have all returned at this opportune time.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: You hear that, scaredy-cat? You're the ace of the Ten-Lords Commission.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I know you're trying to comfort me... but that sounded a little weird.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You need to start filtering out the stuff you don't wanna hear. That's what I do.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: The heliobi are aggressive beings, but they cannot shake their desire for a flesh and blood body. And yet, during the 38 years you have worked for the Ten Lords, you have been constantly able to suppress the monster within your tail and maintain your personality. You are already a fitting judge. Be confident.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: On that point, none of the other judges can surpass you.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Suppress the monster... B—But I don't think I've ever had to suppress Tail! I guess we're more like... friends?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Friends!? Bah! I don't make friends with food.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hehe, "Mr. Tail," puny fragments like us were deprived of Ignamar's power long ago... If a little girl can subdue us, then perhaps it's time for some humility.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Shut your trap!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Though Furynox is powerful, we have a chance of suppressing them if we can break them into multiple fragments.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: You have a sound plan, Your Honor... and since the stage is set, allow me to offer my assistance. Let's find somewhere more open first... like Swallowsong Pavilion, over there.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Let's listen to Cirrus's plan.
Wait, let me think about it.
Let's go.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I understand. Take your time.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Cirrus already helped us in the illusion maze. Maybe... we can trust them for now?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Cirrus may have ulterior motives.
Both you and Madam Xueyi are here. They can't escape.
You can believe whatever you like. I just want to get out of here. That's all I want.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Yes, yes, you're right. I can't escape. Do you trust me now?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I—I guess we can go with Cirrus's plan. It's not like we have any of our own...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Have you made up your mind?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Let's listen to Cirrus's plan.
Wait, let me think about it.
Let's go.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I understand. Take your time.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Tail... Mr. Tail...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What happened to Tail...?
Huohuo...
Tail distracted Cirrus... He helped us so much... B—But now he's gone...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I can't sense him anywhere... He's gone.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What kind of judge am I...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: If I were stronger, Mr. Tail wouldn't have had to sacrifice himself...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It was because of him that I ended up in this terrible job...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...and I've thought so much about how much better my life would be if I never met him... but now that he's actually gone... I feel so empty inside...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I really am useless... I've been looking forward to this day for so long, but now that it's here... I don't feel happy at all.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Heliobi don't die that easily.
He's free now.
Wait, you're right... Madam Xueyi said that heliobi are eternal flames that will never burn away. Mr. Tail... He must still be out there somewhere.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...I guess he is...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Don't worry, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]... I'm okay. I need to pull myself together and finish the job...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh, the Ten-Lords Commission contacted Miss Guinaifen's friend — Miss Sushang. I can't leave my post, so... could you let Miss Sushang know what happened...? She'll be relieved.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The one possessing Huohuo... seems to have disappeared. I don't know if I should be happy or sad for her...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Never mind. I've never been good at figuring out emotions.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Thank you for your assistance, Nameless. Reinforcements from the Ten-Lords Commission will be here soon, and Guinaifen will be sent to an apothecary.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Your body seems to be severely malfunctioning.
I don't see Judge Hanya anywhere...
Is Cirrus dead?
It is only an artificial ingenium body. I can swap into another one easily. Do not worry.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Hanya returned to the Ten-Lords Commission after you left. She is coming with the reinforcements as we speak.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: No. The demon lives on. They even possessed a young spiritfarer under my command. "As Starfire Essences, the heliobi will never die" — the records in the Ten-Lords Commission's evil-binding tomes were all real...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Cirrus lost most of their power and poses no danger for the time being. But they will remain a threat for as long as they exist...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Thankfully, the Ten-Lords Commission had prepared other sacred vessels to suppress the heliobi. We will construct a matrix all over this abandoned garden and seal the heliobi within. The Xianzhou will live to see another day.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: We can leave the rest to the Ten-Lords Commission from here... Even I feel like I need a rest.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...Grahhhh, don't even think about sealing me in the matrix!
rows.speaker: Possessed Spiritfarer

rows.text: You wretched fools! Tail, the judges, you... One day...
rows.speaker: Possessed Spiritfarer

rows.text: ...one day, sooner or later, I'll tear you all to pieces. I'll crunch your bones to dust, sap every drop of your strength, and spit you out into the dirt where you belong...
rows.speaker: Possessed Spiritfarer

rows.text: ...Cirrus?
Leave the kid alone.
What tricks can you possibly pull as you are now?
Goodbye.
Already forgetting me?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Wanna hug, sweety?
I hope you repent.
Tsk, your human tongues are no less poisonous than ours.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Heliobi are faced with only a single punishment — eternal imprisonment. They can lock me up, but they can't kill me.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Kid? As a spiritfarer, he's already experienced more than you could in a lifetime.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: For as long as I'm sealed in the matrix, I will inhabit this body. The judges can stick as many talismans and pour as much enchanted water on this flesh as they like — I don't care. As long as they want to save their own, I still have a bargaining chip.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: There are many, [Trailblazer]... I will exist forever.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I have lived for countless years. I existed before the Alliance was even an idea. And once the Alliance has turned to dust, I will continue to exist for countless more Amber Eras.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I can wait. I'll wait for humans to let their guard down. I'll wait till the matrix drawn over Fyxestroll Garden collapses. Time and opportunity will always be on my side.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...We will meet again.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I wasn't the only heliobus to escape when the Creation Furnace was destroyed... there are more of us than the mere few in Fyxestroll Garden. Where are they now? And what will they do to the Luofu?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I look forward to seeing how the Ten-Lords Commission responds in the coming days...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Cirrus stares at you in silence, and you can tell from their eyes that they are conspiring.
Little Gui kinda gave me an outline of what happened in the apothecary... Can you tell me more?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You explain what happened in Fyxestroll Garden to Sushang, and she seems to realize the seriousness of the situation...
Thanks for telling me everything. I didn't think things would get so out of hand...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I would've been able to help you if I were there too... and maybe Little Gui wouldn't have ended up in the apothecary... *sigh*
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You don't need to worry about Little Gui. She won't be able to sit still, even in a sick ward. I'm sure she'll come find you again in no time.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I'm heading to the apothecary to check up on her. Catch you later.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Whoa, this place feels pure evil... Hee-hee, time to get some footage.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I wonder if this thumbnail would be approved...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Shh, follow me. Keep quiet and tread lightly...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Hey, hey, it looks like there's someone up ahead. Let's go around.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Let's go this way. It's quicker...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Miss Huohuo, can we have Mr. Tail come out for a photo?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Miss Guinaifen, I'm on official duty right now...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It's so quiet... It's getting scarier and scarier...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Please stay close to me...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Did you hear that!? Wh—What was that sound?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wait, wait, wait — stop.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...There are Ten-Lords Commission spiritfarers on patrol. Let's go the other way — we'll head to the Foxsomn Tomb first, then cut through the Locufox Forest.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We need to find Miss Guinaifen, first... Stay close to me — please...!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I thought I'd lost you, too. I'm so scared... Please don't leave me here all on my own...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Then allow me! As a streamer, I've done my fair share of research. Let me find my script...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Sure, I guess now's not really a good time for stories... Don't worry — I can sum it up in a single sentence.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I know, right? I did a lot of research before I decided to film here...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Ugh, man, is it that obvious? I paid Mr. Xiyan to write it up for me. Sounded a little too professional, huh?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I know it's easy to cast doubt, but the Ten-Lords Commission actually showed up this time.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...A passenger on the Astral Express and a guest of the Seat of Divine Foresight. You assisted the Cloud Knights in resolving the Ambrosial Arbor calamity and are a friend of the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: A—Are you really selling me out that fast? Whatever, I'll take the hit... It's true, I persuaded {M#him}{F#her} to come along.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: You are a passenger on the Astral Express and a guest of the Seat of Divine Foresight. You assisted the Cloud Knights in resolving the Ambrosial Arbor calamity and are a friend of the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Tell me, Guinaifen. Why did you return here?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: It's so dark in here... It feels like we're being watched...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Did anyone ever tell you the scary stories about Fyxestroll Garden?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: "Wandering Fox Spirits and Ghostly Tails..." Fyxestroll Garden was originally a garden delve constructed by a foxian craftmaster. It was a place for their kin to rest, write poems, and feast... et cetera et cetera.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: It's said the elite pilots of the foxians were almost wiped out in the Denizens of Abundance Wars thirty years ago. People went to the Foxsomn Tomb in Fyxestroll Garden to grieve for the departed... Because of this, Fyxestroll Garden rarely saw visitors and was bereft of joy.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Over time, Fyxestroll Garden became full of flickering ghostly flames, and weeping lamentations echoed through the air. The rumor that the garden was haunted spread like wildfire among Xianzhou Luofu residents.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Fyxestroll Garden used to be a garden delve, but people started coming here to mourn fallen foxian fighters at the Foxsomn Tomb, and rumors spread that the garden was haunted.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Speaking of which, we have to avoid running into the judges. If we get kicked out, it'll all be for nothing.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Anyway, that's the background. Let's keep moving, and watch your step...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: At ease, Wraith Warden. These two are not your enemies.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Understood, Your Honor.
rows.speaker: Aurumaton Spectral Envoy

rows.text: [Trailblazer], look how pale she is! And it seems like her eyes aren't even focusing... Is she a ghost?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: As a member of the Ten-Lords Commission, you may as well consider me a member of the dead. I am a judge, alias "Hanya." Of the four duties of detention, incarceration, interrogation, and punishment, I'm responsible for interrogation. Therefore, I know a thing or two about you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Guinaifen, an Outworlder, unemployed... You entered Fyxestroll Garden with Sushang, a Cloud Knight, the day before yesterday.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Huh? Unemployed? I'm a {RUBY_B#juggler}street performer{RUBY_E#} and a streamer who reports on current events! A streamer! It's a legit operation!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: As for this one here...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: H—Hello... I'm a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission. My name is Huohuo.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: As a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission, you should speak with more confidence, Huohuo.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...O—Okay.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Regardless whose idea it was... This place has been designated as a restricted area. No one is allowed to enter.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: ...{M#He's}{F#She's} the Nameless? From the train?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Uh, no reason. I haven't posted anything for ages, so I wanted to film some ghosts for my videos... hehe.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We have already told you there are no ghosts on the Xianzhou — it is a ridiculous superstition. As a resident of the Xianzhou, you should refrain from believing or spreading rumors.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: But I saw them! They had ghostly flames coming out of their body, and they were cackling! And Sushang saw them too—
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Miss Guinaifen, it's hard to explain, but those things aren't ghosts. Please don't bring legends from your home world onto the Xianzhou...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The roaming entities you saw are extremely dangerous energy parasites... We call them "heliobi."
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...I... Really? I don't believe it. "Heliobi"? What's that? Ohh, I get it — "heliobi" is just another word for "ghost" on the Xianzhou, right? That's gotta be it.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Maybe we should let Mr. Tail out for a bit... M—Mr. Tail?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I heard you, I heard you! Tsk, unbelievable... What am I, her pet?
Mr. Tail...?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I'm a heliobus! We're not ghosts. Got it? Now scram!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: GHOOOOOOOOST!!!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Guinaifen? Where are you? Huohuo, stay close...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Huohuo? Oh no. Where did she go...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is this... a mirror? It looks a little creepy...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hehe, go — find all those clues your judge friend left behind. Find the talismans...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You can trust me. I want to leave this place, too. We are useful to each other.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: In any case, It doesn't matter if you don't trust me. It's not like you can be rid of me, hahaha.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I feel much safer with you here... Still feel like I'm gonna faint, though...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: May the Arbiter protect us!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hehe, you fought well... you were fighting for your survival, after all...
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: I'll take that as my invitation to inhabit you for a while...
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: Who are you? What do you want?
I said no! Get out!
Fine. Just stay put and don't cause trouble.
Oh, my delicious host, you taste so special... different from anyone else I've ever possessed. But what is this at your core? A Sun? Agh! It burns!
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: You can call me Cirrus. As for what I want... rest assured — I only want to leave this place... I have no desire to harm you.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Argh, resisting are we...? Impressive willpower! How painful, how delectable!
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: You're different from anyone else I've ever possessed... but what is this at your core? A Sun? Agh! It burns!
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: Worry not, I have no interest in making you my home — I'll be gone before you know it. Let's get along while it lasts, shall we?
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: You can call me Cirrus. I only want to leave this place... I have no desire to harm you.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...Incredible, such a relaxed specimen — a soft cake of a host... It's almost as if... as if this body doesn't even belong to you? What makes you so detached, young {M#man}{F#lady}?
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: And what is this at your core? A Sun? Agh! It burns!
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: Never mind. I won't be staying for long, so let's get along while it lasts, shall we?
rows.speaker: Unknown Heliobus

rows.text: You can call me Cirrus. I only want to leave this place... I have no desire to harm you.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Allow me to explain what's happening... The Xianzhou natives call it a "ghost lock." You're walking in a circle, and no amount of walking will get you out of it.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: So, I'm going to help you break free of the circle that Furynox created, and you're going to help me evade the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission. It's a win-win... How does that sound?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: What did you just say? Who's "Furynox?"
I've already found clues that can get me out of here...
Fine. This is just a strategic partnership.
I refuse to work with you.
You must have figured out that I'm not the master of this place... It was created by another heliobus named Furynox.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Unfortunately, I'm the only one who can help you escape from here.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You mean the talismans left behind by "little lost fox judge"? Those won't help you.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Now that I'm possessing you, I can make you see things that you couldn't see before.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Good. I'm glad we understand each other.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: What a stubborn fool — you won't ever get out of here without my help. Anyway, I'm not here to ask your opinion.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: As a courtesy, I shall leave you intact, for the time being... As soon as I get what I want, I'll be gone.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Now, go and look at those talismans again — the paper dolls. You'll know where to go.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Stop. Do you remember our deal? You need to help me evade capture.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: There's a judge up ahead. What, are you scared?
I'm getting her out of here, too.
I keep my promises.
I did NOT make a deal with you.
Ha! THAT judge? I can taste her fear from miles away! That coward has no right calling herself a judge.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: But... that thing attached to her is the tricky part. That's something I don't wish to face.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Ugh... Is this what humans call "sympathy"? How acerbic. Yuck...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Mm, I can taste your integrity — such a rich flavor. A little hard to digest...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Aren't you a stubborn one? But that's okay. You'll come around once you've walked a few more circles in this place.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Forget about the judge — just get us both out of here.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...Wait! Please don't leave me!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Please, I'm begging you! Can you please come closer? I'm so scared...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Um, have you seen Miss Guinaifen? I still haven't found her. Is she gonna be okay...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Let's go find her.
She's probably trapped somewhere around here.
Forget about her — I got possessed by a heliobus!
Give it up. Guinaifen was probably eaten by the heliobi already.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: H—H—How can that be!? If that could happen to someone as lively as Miss Guinaifen... that means I'm in even more danger...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: (Did I really just say that...?)
(Did Guinaifen really get eaten by heliobi?)
(Hehe... Did you know that the larynx is the easiest muscle to control in the human body?)
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: (Why don't you take a guess?)
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you can find the way out, right? Please take me with you...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ugh, not this again! You're a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission — why are you always begging others for help?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You know I'm not cut out to be a judge. I thought maybe if I worked long enough in the Ten-Lords Commission, I'd get braver. But now... I know it's impossible.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Tsk, useless brat. Why was I sealed in with someone like you?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You talk tough all day long, then let both of us get stuck in a trap... Who's the useless brat now!?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Calm down! I'll get you out of here!
I can't find the way out either. It's all up to you.
HELP! I got possessed by a heliobus!
There's no point in following me. I'm leaving, and you're not coming with me. Goodbye!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah! No! P—Please don't leave. Wait, please...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I didn't say that!
Cirrus, you beast...
(Oh, but you did... and can you swear that you don't want to leave her behind? Not even a little?)
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: (Beast? From a taxonomic perspective, I believe you're closer to that definition...)
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: (Oh, you're not gonna fight back anymore? Then let me make up some lines. Just be good and say it with me.)
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission needs to overhaul their hiring criteria. How did someone as useless as you ever become a judge?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: *sob*
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hey, cut it out. I'm the only one around here who gets to tell this kid off... Me and those other judges. Got that!?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Wait. Hold on. I smell something familiar...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Cirrus... it's you. Still a fan of your pathetic ventriloquist act, I see.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Haha... Hahahaha! Oh, this is funny! This is just too funny! I thought you'd already escaped the Furnace's destiny of torture!?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Who would have thought that a piece of Ignamar the Great — the fragment with the most fight in it — would become a guard dog sealed inside a crybaby...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Oh! Forgive me! Did I say guard dog? No, no, no, that won't do... You're just a guard dog's "tail," right? Just a tail, a tail, a tail!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Laugh while you can, coward! I'm gonna swallow you whole the second you leave that {M#boy's}{F#girl's} body!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: H—How t—t—terrifying, ahahaha...! The joke's on you!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You couldn't leave that judge's body if you tried! You can't eat her, let alone escape from her. Ahahaha, "Mr. Tail." You're pathetic~
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Darn it! Think of something, you wimp!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: {M#M—Mr.}{F#M—Miss} [Trailblazer], take this talisman and stick it to your body — it'll temporarily suppress the heliobus's influence...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: *sob*
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hey! {M#Boy}{F#Girl}! Say something nice to Huohuo. Her crying is like a mosquito in my ear.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: [Trailblazer], it's you! I—I finally found another living soul!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm so happy! I thought I was gonna be stuck here forever... I'm so happy to see you!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ahhhh, what a feast! Human emotions are simply delicious. Your sorrowful tears are like bottles of potent wine~
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Don't you ever talk through me like that again.
Does it amuse you to make a little girl cry?
Hehe, I'm simply enjoying my freedom. Didn't you use the talisman already? I'm tame as a kitten...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Does the Xianzhou sail through the cosmos?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: For a heliobus that enjoys provoking your weak human sentiments, I can assure you there is nothing more amusing.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Now, don't forget about our deal. I will leave only once I've got what I wanted.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Say, are you still possessing me?
(Leave quietly)
Of course. Surely you don't think I've left you just because you can see me? So naive!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Cirrus talks nothing but nonsense... but even so, Huohuo has a sensitive heart. You. Go say something nice to the girl.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Aren't you looking down on her all the time?
Why don't you go say something nice to her?
Yes, which is why she needs other organic beings like you to support her! Get it? Go!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Keep dreaming. I have nothing nice to say to anyone.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You can roam free even though you're sealed?
(Leave quietly)
Roam free!? Is that what you call this? This is as far as I can get from her.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You think I'd be here playing house with you numbskulls if I could fly away?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: *sob*
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm sorry, Huohuo... Are you okay?
Stay strong, Huohuo — you're a judge.
It's not your fault... It was that bad heliobus making us fight...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...If I were any other judge, you'd already be saved...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Someone as nice as you wouldn't say such mean things — only a possession would make you act like that. Still, what the heliobus said was true...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I've always been shy and scared... My life's been a nightmare ever since Tail possessed me...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: When I was at school, people were always asking why my tail was on fire... Everywhere I went, people would notice.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh, so it's all my fault? If you'd just let me devour you at the start, I could've spared you the trouble!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Th—Then I got into the Ten-Lords Commission. Everyone there is weird, so I thought I'd found somewhere I belonged. But the job... the job is too dangerous! I have to fight demons and ghosts and bad guys every day...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I... I'm just not cut out for it. If I make it back alive... I'm handing in my resignation.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Who thought making a heliophobe with a heliobus in her tail hunt heliobi was a good idea... I'm sorry, I've been so useless...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You're doing very well already, Huohuo.
You're the one who left the paper dolls for me. Thank you.
...R—Really?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...I—I'm glad it helped...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You hear that? Stop crying. You're useful. And your paper dolls are useful too.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Ugh, I've had enough of this! As soon I swallow that coward Cirrus, I'm gonna devour this little crybaby too!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: What a pity that "Mr. Tail" is nothing like he used to be. If we still had our old power, we could forget about this maze and devour its creator, Furynox.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Your old power?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Well, "Mr. Tail," seems she knows nothing about your past... Little missy, do you know why the heliobi are gathered in this abandoned garden instead of seizing human habitations?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...Team-building?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Look! Th—There's a mirror behind the door...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: (Didn't I see a similar mirror when I was dragged in?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That... sound... Huohuo... this way.
rows.speaker: Voice From the Mirror

rows.text: What's going on...? Th—There's a voice in the mirror?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Huohuo, are you in the mirror? I finally found you!
rows.speaker: Voice From the Mirror

rows.text: Madam Xueyi!?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Fyxestroll Garden has been enveloped by an unknown power... You must be careful!
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: We still haven't found Miss Guinaifen... I don't know where she went...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The task at hand is to save you from this illusion. Come. Pass through the mirror and come to our side.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Hey, hey! I'm trying to help you. Go and look at the clues.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...Do I have to make you drag yourself over there?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Are we... above Fyxestroll Garden?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hmm, so many bronze mirrors. Could it be that...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Not all the mirrors are real.
This illusion is shifting.
You're right, {M#boy}{F#girl}. This place is changing. It's trying to stop us from escaping.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: But one of these mirrors must contain the exit, right? Let's check them all...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: This is the exit, you useless brat! Come here!
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Ah! M—Madam Xueyi can be a bit of a meanie, but she'd never talk to me like that... That doesn't sound like her... Come to think of it, it kinda sounds like Tail.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Constructive criticism!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hmph... Let's go look at the other mirrors.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...This isn't the right place. We picked the wrong bronze mirror.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Huohuo, sweetie! Come to big sister Xueyi.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Yuck — that judge would never say something so sickly.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Let's go look at the next mirror.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The situation in Fyxestroll Garden is getting worse. Why have you not left? Is something the matter in there?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Over here, that sounds like the real Madam Xueyi.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The real Madam Xueyi? Are there pretenders inside the illusion?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: There are multiple bronze mirrors here.
The heliobus is trying to trick us.
I see. Do not be afraid. Huohuo knows me well — she will be able to discern me from the counterfeits.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: B—But what if I can't tell the difference?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You must trust yourself. Come.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hurry, Huohuo. Pass through the mirror and come to me.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...Wait. I want to ask a few questions... to see if you're the real person.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What's the relationship between Xueyi and Hanya?
How did Huohuo manage to become a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission?
That's all I have to ask.
We are both Judges of the Ten-Lords Commission. Evidently, we are colleagues.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: The heliobus that trapped us here wouldn't know that Madam Xueyi and Madam Hanya are twin sisters...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: A powerful heliobus possessed her tail... It is a power that I dream of having for myself.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Never knew you were so popular, Mr. Tail...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Tsk, very funny...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: So, we're gonna...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hurry, Huohuo. Pass through the mirror and come to me.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...Wait. I want to ask a few questions... to see if you're the real person.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What's the relationship between Xueyi and Hanya?
How did Huohuo manage to become a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission?
That's all I have to ask.
Who is Hanya...?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Uh, never mind. Forget I said anything.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Likely through some secret means that I am unaware of.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I—I didn't have any connections at all!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: So, we're gonna...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hurry, Huohuo. Pass through the mirror and come to me.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...Wait. I want to ask a few questions... to see if you're the real person.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What is the relationship between Judge Xueyi and Judge Hanya?
How did Huohuo manage to become a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission?
That's all I have to ask.
Hanya is my younger sister, but this alone cannot prove who I am. Ask me something else.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: "By decree of the Ten-Lords: Spiritfarer Huohuo is skilled and diligent, capable and worthy of officialdom. She is hereby promoted to the position of judge."
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I still remember the decree for her promotion.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: That's her! This has to be Madam Xueyi behind the mirror...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: So, we're gonna...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Come here, Huohuo. Come through the mirror.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I—I need to ask you some questions about myself first...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What do you think about Huohuo's personality?
What do you think about Huohuo's tail?
That's all I have to ask.
...As a judge responsible for capturing criminals, her cowardice is a dereliction of duty. I will reprimand her severely once you leave the illusion.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Huh? That doesn't sound like Madam Xueyi... right?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Stupid girl. This is obviously a fake!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Her tail will be extracted and suppressed after the job is over.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Hehe, you fraud... I'll deal with you once I get out!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: So, we're gonna...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Come here, Huohuo. Come through the mirror.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I—I need to ask you some questions about myself first...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What do you think about Huohuo's personality?
What do you think about Huohuo's tail?
That's all I have to ask.
Her caution is a skill all judges of the Ten-Lords Commission should possess.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Ha, that's a funny way of describing cowardice. Nauseating.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: It's the most powerful fragment of Ignamar's demise. Who would have guessed it still contained so much power after so many years...?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Ha, you've given the game away.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: So, we're gonna...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hurry, Huohuo. This should be the last mirror.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I—I need to ask you some questions about myself first...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What do you think about Huohuo's personality?
What do you think about Huohuo's tail?
That's all I have to ask.
She will be expelled after tonight's operation. She is not fit for her job at the Ten-Lords Commission.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Really? So I don't even need to write a resignation letter...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Stupid girl. This is obviously a trick!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: An insignificant demon... I can't wait to devour it myself.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Aha! Not even trying to hide your true colors!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: So, we're gonna...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pass through the mirror.
Investigate other mirrors.
But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm not the best judge of things... but these mirrors...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Not a single one is the real thing!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: None of them show Madam Xueyi as I know her to be...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: That puppet judge never respected me, but she also never let her guard down.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I've spent a long time working with Madam Xueyi. She's always known that I'm scared and timid, but she never told me off...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Tsk, the Ten-Lords Commission never cared a wink about your frail constitution. You're the only one who makes a big deal about it...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...and as long as you don't drag me down, I don't really care how much of a coward you are, either...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tail...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hey, hey, hey — get away from me...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Your judgment was pretty accurate.
You two actually get along pretty well...
See? People say good things about you. What are you gonna do about it?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: What do you know!? Tsk... And what are we even talking about? We need to focus...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: The illusion wants to keep us in, but it can't possibly keep expanding its borders forever. I think there's gotta be a fourth mirror somewhere.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ha, I didn't think you'd be able to, hehe. All these years and you finally started to grow up a bit.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hurry, Huohuo. This should be the last mirror.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...I don't wanna go back the way we came, but I need to ask some questions about myself to make sure!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What do you think about Huohuo's personality?
What do you think about Huohuo's tail?
Everyone is different. A judge is not a soldier, and they need more than just courage.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: It is the decree of the Ten Lords for Huohuo to be elevated to a judge. There must be some meaning in it.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...Just what do those old fogeys see in this coward?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: It is merely a sealed heliobus, a tool carrying out the will of the Ten Lords.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Hmph. I may not like it, but that is how she sees me.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Let's go. This is the right mirror.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...but there's an exception to everything. "Mr. Tail," I thought you'd escaped to freedom... Who could've guessed you'd be sealed in this tiny foxian girl? Humiliating...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Sealed my foot! My power was weak when I ran into this fox child. It was bad luck, nothing more!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hilarious! It's a pity "Mr. Tail" didn't devour you... He might've recovered his power and turned the Xianzhou upside down... just like Ignamar did!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Why did the heliobi challenge the general?
Do you have a grudge against the Xianzhou?
Why? Does there have to be a reason?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The official answer is that the Xianzhou is sealing heliobi in a cage and forcing them to supply energy to the ship... In reality, however, we just want to fight the general... and see what the Xianzhou is truly made of!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Grudge? How shallow. If you must know the forces behind our actions...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...there's a pinch of envy — envy towards the potent emotions you corporeal beings have. Then there's a dash of aggression — the desire to see whether the heliobi or bodies of flesh and blood are stronger. Lastly, there's a drizzle of desire. We desire to possess your physical bodies, so we can eat, kill, love, and hate.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: We heliobi were carefree lifeforms, but were tainted with the illness of humanity once we came into contact with it. It's humanity's fault for having such intense emotions and desires — now, we can never, never return to the purity of our past.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I want to be free again! I want to return to the cosmos! Mr. Tail, you don't want to regroup with the fragments, and you don't want to be her tail forever — why don't you return with me to the great beyond?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...Don't get ahead of yourself, Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: That's impossible. Mr. Tail was sealed by the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission. He can't escape... and neither can you...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Mirrors again... what a surprise.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Look around us, Mr. Tail. I think we're at the edge of the illusion...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Maybe these are the only mirrors left?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I think there's a mirror on that floating island... but it's a bit far away...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: C—C—Could I crawl my way there...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Quit stalling and get on with it!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: It seems like we're ready. Now, we just have to get out.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: (Wasn't I... just here a moment ago?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (I need to look closely around this place again... Maybe I can break out of the cycle.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (What is going on? I looped back again?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Isn't this... where I started?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (It seems like the paths here are being twisted by some sort of illusion...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hehe, you've noticed it, no? All roads are but puzzles in this place...
rows.speaker: Faraway Voice

rows.text: Come, lost one! Do you desire to leave? Then come and find me!
rows.speaker: Faraway Voice

rows.text: Hey, use your eyes... I made the talismans float. Pay attention!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: There are so many paper dolls over there. Surely your judge friend left some clues for you. Won't you take a look?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Do you understand? This story of the supernatural is in the illusory maze for a reason. It contains the clue to help us get out of here. Come back and read it again if you need to.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Hehe, see? I told you I'd help you. The way out is straight ahead. Just keep going...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: That voice sounds familiar...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Wahhhh! That door just opened on its own!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Less screaming, more thinking — this is an opportunity, is it not? Let's go in and check it out.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: (There's a book of ghost stories here, just like before. Could it have anything to do with this puzzle?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...We already passed through this mirror. The Madam Xueyi behind this mirror is most likely a fake. Let's not go there again.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The gloomy doors are silent. You follow the instruction in the book and knock on the doors, three times on the left, three times on the right.
The door will not open without the proper courtesies. Return from where you came, visitors...
rows.speaker: Voice From Behind the Door

rows.text: Everything returns to normal.
The gloomy doors are silent. You follow the instruction in the book and knock on the doors, three times on the left, three times on the right.
The courtesies have been performed. Enter, oh honored guest.
rows.speaker: Voice From Behind the Door

rows.text: The door cracks open a sliver. Through the crack, you notice that there is no one behind the door, as if the voice from before have never existed.
Of course!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The general who fought for the Luofu against the heliobus was named "Teng Xiao."
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...The Ten-Lords Commission records say that Ignamar was soundly defeated by General Teng Xiao...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: (...Where am I?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Is this... Fyxestroll Garden? But it looks different somehow...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (... I should keep moving.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hmm, you have a strange scent on you. You must be...
rows.speaker: Mysterious Voice

rows.text: I have heard the whispers of the leaves that fall in Fyxestroll Garden. The flames weep and profess to me that a powerful mortal approaches...
rows.speaker: Mysterious Voice

rows.text: They carry the scent of a great battle... with none other than Phantylia...
rows.speaker: Mysterious Voice

rows.text: You... You are the one who drove Phantylia away...
rows.speaker: Mysterious Voice

rows.text: ...What power... Your presence alone is delicious enough to make one tremble!
rows.speaker: Mysterious Voice

rows.text: Let me taste you, please! One bite! Just one bite! I can't wait to savor you!
rows.speaker: Mysterious Voice

rows.text: When I was littler, I saw a ball of fire that looked like it was about to turn to embers...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I felt sorry for it, so I picked it up and put it on my tail... and then... Mr. Tail tried to eat me! If the judges hadn't arrived, it would've been over...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Bah, I did no such thing — you're barely big enough to be an appetizer.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: All the pain I've suffered since I met you must be retribution for my stupidity back then...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Aaaah—
rows.speaker: Furynox's Fragment

rows.text: Fragments of Furynox have been sealed in the gourd.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Thank the Arbiter!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Let us go. Let us go!
rows.speaker: Furynox's Fragment

rows.text: ...There are plenty of heliobi in the gourd now. Let's go and meet up with Madam Xueyi.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You've heard the story of Ignamar and the great heliobus's glorious fight against the general. They were an entity born of many heliobi fusing together...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...but heliobi are gradually tainted by the emotions and desires of those we possess. We tend to spite each other and don't like to fuse together — it's like having multiple personalities inside a single head. It leads to "infighting..."
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: A powerful heliobus like Ignamar or Furynox might be able to swallow a lesser heliobus and placate them for a while...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...but this internal balance is easily broken when exposed to external forces — just like how we were torn apart and reborn after Ignamar fought the general.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Therefore... this might be the way to defeat Furynox. We can cause them to break apart and reduce their power, then the Ten-Lords Commission can use their sacred vessels to seal up all of Furynox's fragments.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I have a question. Why are you betraying your own kin? Why would you help the Xianzhou when we have sealed you for so long?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Why? Must heliobi always have a reason for their behavior? Perhaps I don't want Furynox to devour me. Perhaps I dislike idiots who use force and nothing else. Perhaps I wish to fight the general myself...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...or maybe I just want to do a favor for the Ten-Lords Commission that will ensure I can leave here in one piece?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: We should allow Cirrus to go ahead with their plan.
Don't believe Cirrus!

Judges of the Ten-Lords Commission always keep our promises. If you can truly deal with the problem at hand, I will ask for your freedom from the Ten Lords. However, I cannot guarantee the outcome of the appeal.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: How conventional. Fine, I accept... but you better keep your promise, puppet.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Hehe, me and Furynox were "furnacemates..." I know them well. They are powerful, but as naive as a child and obsessed with victory. I only need to say three things to incite them.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I'll need your body for a while longer.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Furynox! Furynox...!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: *There is a vague sound from far away. A response, possibly.*
Before you duel the general, why don't you fight me?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Cirrus? What makes you worth my time, weakling?
rows.speaker: Distant Voice

rows.text: I've turned this garden into my territory and made the dogs of the Ten Lords my puppets! As soon as the general arrives, the heliobi will have our rematch. Why should I fight my own at this crucial moment?
rows.speaker: Distant Voice

rows.text: That group of amateurs you've put together? Hah. They're nothing compared to me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I have already obtained the most wonderful pawn for myself — a piece that once expelled Phantylia!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Phantylia? Phantylia! I remember! What a wonderful host... I want it!
rows.speaker: Distant Voice

rows.text: Then send the spiritfarers under your control to find me. If you can defeat this Nameless I'm possessing, then you can swallow me up and let my strength aid you in your fight against the general. What do you say?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Deal! My pawns and I will show you no mercy!
rows.speaker: Distant Voice

rows.text: See? Easy-peasy.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Tsk, does that mean all the spiritfarers out there have fallen? What a useless army.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Does that mean we'll be fighting our friends...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh, do puppets feel empathy? Or do you not wish to defeat Furynox anymore? We heliobi think of such matters as business transactions. As long as something can bring us victory, we will destroy everything — even allies and kin.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Make the decision. Furynox's pawns — your companions — must be destroyed.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...Please come over here. I need to give you something.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: You two, take this before we fight Furynox.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: This is the Lunaumbra Gourd, a sacred vessel made by the Artisanship Commission. The Ten-Lords Commission has made some changes to it to better suppress heliobi. After you fight the puppets controlled by Furynox, make sure you seal their heliobi fragments in here.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Also...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I'll look after Huohuo.
I'll go easy on the spiritfarers.
Her time as a judge has been brief — she is still inexperienced. Apart from that, please also have mercy on the spiritfarers that have fallen under Furynox's control.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: The Ten Lords will not forget your acts of kindness. Thank you.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Mr. Tail, we're gonna fight some really dangerous enemies now. Please lend me your strength, too.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh-ho? Sounds like someone finally learned to talk tough.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I would've believed you if your legs weren't shaking so much!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Don't point that out! It took me a lot of effort to be this brave! All this time I've just been hiding behind {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. I'm such a bad judge...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Madam Xueyi said those possessed by a heliobus can't get possessed again... I'm the only person who can help everyone!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Exactly! You're welcome, by the way... So, what are we waiting for? Let's go!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Huohuo, though I am of ingenium body, I too am feeling a sliver of fear.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Madam Xueyi... you're afraid too?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Faced with a demon that can manipulate life at will, of course I'm afraid... Afraid that I won't ever work with my sister again.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Huohuo, I'm afraid too.
Afraid or not, we're still gonna beat the heck out of it!
...I—I guess if even you two are afraid, then... I—I feel a little better now.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Let's go! I will find my own way to defeat the pawns possessed by Furynox... and before that foolish heliobus has realized what's happening, I will suppress all of their fragments within the Lunaumbra Gourd.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: ...So we'll need to activate the Evil Binding Matrix, right?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Once my task is done, I will meet you at the Verdantia Terrace and activate the Evil Binding Matrix at its matrix core.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Okay.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Those are... possessed Wraith Wardens...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Don't expect me to hold back.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: If Furynox is so powerful, why would they allow themself to break apart so easily?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The stronger you are, the more you underestimate your enemies... sometimes being weak and humble is the way to survive.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: It's Madam Xueyi... and Miss Guinaifen! Thank goodness she's alright...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: There are so many spiritfarers lying on the floor!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: [Trailblazer]! Huohuo! I'm so glad you're okay!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I have defeated all the spiritfarers controlled by Furynox... It was quite troublesome taking them down without doing any harm.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: How goes your task?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: We're doing well. We've sealed most of Furynox's fragments.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Now, we shall seal the fragments absorbed by the Lunaumbra Gourd into the Evil Binding Matrix. Once Furynox's power has been stripped, it will no longer be able to influence reality in Fyxestroll Garden.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: This gourd is so pretty! Is this what they call a "sacred vessel" on the Xianzhou?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Miss Guinaifen, please be careful... You might feel dizzy if you get too close to the matrix...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It's okay. It's okay. This is my first time seeing the Ten-Lords Commission's exorcising tools up close~
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huohuo, get her away from here!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Her face emotionless, Guinaifen smashes the gourd on the ground and countless heliobi break free.
She faints right after.
Oh no!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Cirrus~ It's Cirrus~ You won~ You won...
rows.speaker: Escaped Heliobi

rows.text: Don't leave us... help us... take us... to restore Ignamar's glory together!
rows.speaker: Escaped Heliobi

rows.text: Muahahahaha⁓
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Thank you, Your Honors, for helping me clear so many obstacles and collect so many heliobus fragments.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I told you I'd leave your body, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: This demon... is quite troublesome...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Is everyone okay!?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: They've consumed too many heliobi...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: We'd die from exhaustion before we manage to weaken it.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: We've still got a chance, puppet...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Cirrus said it themselves. There's a fragile balance when heliobi fuse together.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You know what to do, don't you, Huohuo?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: But...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: But what? Aren't you gonna be living the life you've always wanted once I'm gone?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Ugh, these pawns are no fun. Why don't you join in too, hmm?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I just wanna play a little longer! What's so bad about that?
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Why do I have to live the way grown-ups do?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Grown-ups are always saying "study now and have fun later..."
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: ...but the grown-ups I see at the Alchemy Commission never have time for fun!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Stop chasing us!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Can't you just let me have some fun!?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Why do grown-ups always say that life is harder for them. So weird...
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Weren't grown-ups kids once too?
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Would you spoil the fun for younger you just because older you isn't happy?
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Exactly!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Why do they always talk about things I don't understand!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: I just wanna have fun!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Whew... By the Arbiter... They sure know... how to run...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: That's... the power of a... heliobus!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Catch your breath... before you pass out...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Let's... let's try a new strategy... I don't think we can beat them like this. We need to use our heads...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...Sushang's... gonna use her head...? Now we're really done for...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I barely broke a sweat.
I think I'm hyperventilating.
Hee-hee! I'm a big meany head!
You're right. Sorr... Sowwie!
Yo boss, maybe we should let her off with a warning this time?
I never thought this would be behind the door...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Remember, it's just a heliobus illusion...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hey, you over there! Release Lady Bailu!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Don't be a bunch of fun-suckers! She doesn't wanna let anyone take her away!
rows.speaker: Pseudo-Bailu

rows.text: Luxie, they came here looking for me... It's starting to get dark, maybe it's time for me to go back now?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Lulu, didn't we say before that we wouldn't let any grown-ups find us? And never let them take us home? Why... why did you change your mind?
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Hmm... you're right! Grown-ups break their promises, but we don't!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: That's right! Remember, if you ever get hungry, I can conjure up anything you like — berrypheasant skewers, startaro bubble tea — you name it. We have it right here!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Okay! Make some right now!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Not yet — why don't we play a game first? You bad guys over there, okay? You're gonna be in the game too!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Lulu, let's make a run for it — if we escape from them, I'll conjure up all of your favorite snacks and drinks!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Wow! Then what are we waiting for? Let's go!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: We're free from the grown-ups! We can play all day every day!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Wait, stop!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Anyone bring a hunting trap?
Then... good for you! But you should probably catch your breath first... I could hear you panting from a mile away.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ha, you're fine! Just take a breather...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh? We can't hunt the Dragon Lady like a wild beast...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Wait, I have an idea! How about we use a little reverse psychology? Instead of chasing Lady Bailu, we get her to come to us!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Are you serious? Does that little dragon girl look like she's gonna come running over to us?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Chasing Bailu around like this reminds me of something I saw back home when I was a child. On my home planet, resources were scarce, and if you wanted to eat meat you had to risk your life by going deep into the mines to hunt an animal called a sky mink.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Sky minks fly so nimbly and are so alert that even the quickest of hands will have a hard time catching them.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Why are we having story time all of a sudden?
Did you get the meat? How does the story end?
Gather round children!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ugh, don't interrupt! Hear me out. The sky mink's ecology is unique — it lives in symbiosis with a venomous creature called a shrieking lizard. When a sky mink goes out to feed, it lets the lizard protect its young.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: So we used to go to sky mink nests to catch shrieking lizards, instead. When a shrieking lizard gets caught, it calls to the sky mink with a loud shriek to warn it to return to the nest and protect its young... which of course, led the sky mink right to us.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Sounds a little cruel...
Sounds pretty smart...
Well, the competition for survival went two ways — shrieking lizards spew out a potent venom, and failure to take proper precautions cost many a hunter their life.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I'd hesitate to call it that. Shrieking lizards spew out a potent venom — many people lost their lives trying to catch a tiny morsel of meat for dinner.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Nice story. But what's it got to do with chasing Lady Bailu?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Isn't it obvious? If we can catch one Bailu, the other will come running to us!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I remember one of the judges had a precious item called a Lunaumbra Gourd, which could absorb and imprison heliobi... Uh, come to think of it, I think that's the thing I smashed... I wonder if they fixed it?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen
