rows.text: Actually, I have one with me, but it's only effective when a heliobus is close by.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Nice! In that case, you can take the gourd and camp out in a corner — the rest of us will chase Lady Bailu back over here.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: If we catch Lady Bailu, will Luxie really follow her into our trap? Do heliobi really have a sense of loyalty to their victims?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Who knows? Cirrus said that Luxie is kinda childlike — it's worth a try.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Lemme go! I don't wanna be locked in here!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Lady Bailu — please calm down. You're not yourself right now — you're being influenced by a heliobus.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You're lying! I never had playmates. Today I finally found one, and you guys are trying to take them away...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Grown-ups are so mean! As soon as they see children having fun, they wanna ruin it!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Careful! Don't let them manipulate you.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Careful! Don't let them manipulate you.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Phew, sure enough, they walked right into our trap.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Hmph, I was considering letting you join the club and have fun with us... but since you're so determined to spoil everything... I'm afraid we'll have to settle our differences through violence.
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Yes, violence, the only language you grown-ups know how to speak, right? The one you use when you're telling us off!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: I'm sorry, Lulu... Th—The grown-ups won, I can't play with you anymore...
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Luxie, we said we'd never go back with the grown-ups! They break their promises, but we can't!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: There's nothing I can do about it... playtime can't go on forever...
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: ...but we still had lots of fun — let's play again next time!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: There won't be a next time! Huohuo, you know what to do.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Luxie, how long before the next time we can play together?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: We both have many years ahead of us, so in that sense it won't be long at all... but for now I have to leave with these grown-ups!
rows.speaker: Luxie

rows.text: Alright, alright. Lady Bailu, it's getting late — you need to go home now.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: As the heliobus disappears, Bailu's eyes regain their clarity. She has retaken control of herself.
I... everything's so fuzzy... Did I do something bad?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: No need to feel bad, Lady Bailu. You were in a dreamworld — none of it was your fault.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: But... but... I made everyone chase after me for so long... I shouldn't have done that...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: It's only natural to want to escape when strict rules are being forced on you. I know there are a lot of grown-ups trying to control you — telling you what you can and can't do... they're the ones to blame.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I was ready to apologize to everyone... but now you've made me forget what I wanted to say.
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Apologize for what? You know, you and me have a lot in common. I'm almost a grown-up now, but I still miss my childhood days and running about barefoot.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: My big brother used to boss me around... He'd give me chores, constantly telling me to grow up, that kind of thing... Then one day, I decided to rebel. I ran away to prove that I could get by without my family... and eventually settled on the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Whether it's a Dragon Lady like you or an ordinary person like me, I feel like many people's lives follow a similar trajectory.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: One day, you'll have the strength to leave your current situation and move on to the next phase... In the meantime, I suggest you try and cherish the good rather than apologize for the bad.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Hehe, alright, alright, I don't want everyone to feel too sorry for me... Hey, did you ever think about joining the Alchemy Commission as a psychotherapist?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Geez, and there I was pouring my heart out... Now I feel like this kid's lived longer than I have...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Umm, c—can we not linger around here too long? This place is really spooky... Maybe we can chat somewhere else?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The Lunaumbra Gourd is in place. If we can chase Lady Bailu to this spot, we should be able to catch her...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Umm... b—be careful, okay?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: That door over there is the only way out... We'd better close it...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Bailu anticipated your attempt to block her path, but as long as she runs fast enough, she can do whatever she wants.
All is set. Now go on, drive Bailu into the matrix of the Lunaumbra Gourd!
If there exists the Path of "Correction" in this world, then they would surely cast approving glances upon you.
A flash of inspiration hits: You should try opening this door.
An idea pops up: You should try closing this door.
What is this...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: This place is what the Divination Commission calls the "Pathfinder." It's a sandbox game that diviners use to simulate future paths and exercise our minds. But why did the Master Diviner bring us here?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: You want to play a game with us?
Is this where you show us the true nature of destiny?
It's just a game.
This puzzle was designed by you.
I see where she's going with this...
I have no clue what she's thinking...
It's all yours, Qingque.
Of course.
There is more than one path...
You don't even understand what Qingque is saying.
Fu Xuan is breaking free from their grasp!
Now!

That's right. Now listen, [Trailblazer]. If you place an ingenium in this little maze and give it a command, it will find its way to the exit precisely as it was commanded to do so. Are humans not the same as they navigate the path of destiny set before them?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: But you're probably thinking: "humans are not machines, there is more than one path in the universe!"
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Humans are not machines.
There is more than one path in the universe!
And yet machines we are — complex, sophisticated, but machines.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: We are just like the ingenium in this maze — we have no options to speak of... We can only navigate one path — the one that takes us to our destination.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Let's begin. Lead the ingenium to the exit. Show me how many choices destiny gives you.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: It feels like we're just dancing to the heliobus's tune...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We did it!
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Well done. Your choices are as the omniscia foresaw them. You should know that there was only one answer to this puzzle from the beginning, just as destiny has only one path!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Yes, for a puzzle that was designed from the start, choosing any other path would be a pointless mistake.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: But the universe isn't someone's game, and no one is designing puzzles for us to solve. The universe doesn't have a single answer... we can do anything we want while we're in it.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Even if it's the same work every day, I can hide in the library and read a book or find someone to play Celestial Jade with... and that's freedom.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: I never thought slacking off could convince me of anything... the sign of a true scholar! A diviner of the Divination Commission after all!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Sushang, snap out of it! A slacker heliobus is getting into your head!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Qingque, Qingque... For you, life may have a seemingly infinite number of choices. That is because your choices are simply different ways of slacking off and wasting time — they are of no consequence to anything... but for me, choices come with very real consequences.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: That's the most "divinery" thing you've said so far...
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: As the Master Diviner of the Luofu, I have a heavy responsibility. I must comb through the complex threads of destiny day after day, all for the preservation of this giant ship.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Some paths look promising, but lead to an abyss of despair. Then there are small trails that plunge deep into unimaginable darkness. And in the end...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...I realized that we have no real choices. There is only one path to follow, only one way to the optimal solution, even if it is paved with ashes and bitterness.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: There is only one way — and there only ever was.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: What do we do... I don't think we can persuade her...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I have a proposal — why don't we try a more advanced sandbox?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: However long you want to play this game, and whatever tricks you try to pull, I'll happily play along.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...Miss Qingque?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Use your "free will" to guide the ingenium out of the sandbox.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The path changed slightly, but it was just as simple. I'm sure the Master Diviner would say—
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Destiny only has one path. Your choices are just a predetermined solution to the puzzle.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Actually, I don't think I agree. Master Diviner, let's reset the sandbox and give it another go, shall we?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Again? Do it all over again, exactly as it was? You can try it a million times over, and a million times over it is doomed to the same fate — because there is only one path.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Hehe, I see what you're thinking, Qingque... you're an interesting one.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Qingque, I've been thinking through the calculations for this puzzle — there really is only one solution.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: This maze was designed by Keralum. It's no use — there aren't any other solutions. As long as we're playing this so-called game of destiny, we can't win.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: No, there's a second choice. There will always be another choice.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: [Trailblazer], quick, say something to persuade her...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I didn't mean like that...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ready to begin?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Of course there's another solution to this sandbox. [Trailblazer], listen to my idea.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: You're all gonna help, right?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Correct.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Miss Qingque, I don't know how you're planning to solve the puzzle... but I'll support this squad to the end...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Count me in. I'm sure Miss Qingque has something up her sleeve.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: If we can help, I'm in.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I only need two people for my plan to work.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: This is the other solution — the alternative choice. I created a new solution.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Master Diviner, you're not the only one who can design a puzzle, and I don't tread the path of destiny alone.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: ...Hahahaha... you think that by calling on your companions for help, you created a new path out of thin air?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: You're just playing with semantics. I could weave a thousand routes for you, but they lead to the same destination — so what significance is there in having a choice?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Creatures like you don't understand humans.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: The universe is like jade tiles on a game table. When the tiles are shuffled, the outcome is already predetermined.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Which tiles can be played, which tiles are leftover, what kind of hand the person next to you is trying to make — all of these can be determined through calculations. But if everything is just a calculation, the game loses its flavor.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Randomness and adaptability, ambushing your opponent, twists and turns, the balance of the elements — it's a mix of calculations, unknowns, and loss of complete control that makes Celestial Jade the kind of game it is — and those are the same things that give life its color and vibrance.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Do my "choices" at the game table mean nothing if I have a sure loss in front of me? No — the choices are what make the game meaningful in the first place.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: You were right when you said that as Master Diviner, you must comb through the complex threads of destiny day after day, all for the preservation of this giant ship.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: In this vast universe — a game where there are only losers — our Master Diviner is making endless choices, fighting against the odds just so the Luofu can safely travel for another day. Hehe, in my book she's the best player there is.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Why would someone as talented as the Master Diviner go through the trouble of making endless choices if the end result is predetermined?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Heliobus, you cannot fathom the joys of humanity. You are imprisoned by the illusion of destiny, unable to free yourself, and you want everyone who peeks into the future to suffer the same pain as you.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: You... You don't understand humans at all.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Aghhhhh! Don't let them trick you, Fu Xuan! Don't push me away! Don't let her words fool you!
rows.speaker: Keralum

rows.text: Keralum, release the Master Diviner!
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: All right, we're ready.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: And now the second path appears.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Alright, make sure you're paying attention.
(Remain silent.)
The Keralum-possessed master diviner seems more easily enraged than she normally is. Maybe now's not the best time to bother her.
Master Diviner! A—Are you alright?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: I... I'm fine. Just a small headache, nothing more.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: It's normal to experience some discomfort after being possessed by a heliobus, but nothing a few medicinal pellets can't take care of.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Is that... Keralum? Hmph, they may not be the most powerful fragment, but becoming entangled in their illusion can lead to endless despair.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Hurry... just hurry up and... seal me in the darkness...
rows.speaker: Keralum

rows.text: I've foreseen what happens next... you're going to imprison me...
rows.speaker: Keralum

rows.text: Even if I lose, I'll still make choices to lighten the loss — just like the Master Diviner is making choices for her own agenda.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: A heliobus is leading you astray.
I'm not interested in swordsmanship.
The general sent us to bring you back...
What are all these swords doing in Dragonprayer Terrace...?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It must be a heliobus illusion...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Shouldn't we ring the Harmonic Chime and see if we can talk to Yanqing inside the illusion?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Illusion?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Since each of you can see it, wouldn't that mean you'd fallen into the illusion as well?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Don't be alarmed. To me, these swords form a precious arsenal. When I gaze upon any one, a thousand sword fights dance before my eyes — the swordplay far exceeding anything I have learned.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: And better yet, they welcome those who wish to pursue higher realms with open arms.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I know that this is an illusion created by a heliobus. The General sent me to assist the Ten-Lords Commission — I know a thing or two about your work...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: These cosmic flames are not good nor evil, they are simply a mirror... As long as a host's mind is clear, a heliobus cannot control them.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Take me, for example... At this moment, I am free of all distractions... and I see the potential for greatness in these swords. Isn't that right, Master Apyra?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Swordsmanship isn't the only thing you can learn. As long as you want to become stronger, these swords will show you countless ways to do so. Isn't that right, Master Apyra?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: The General? You lie. I've already finished my assignment at the Alchemy Commission. I have no further orders...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: This is my own time. I came here to learn from Master Apyra... to learn from these swords.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Apyra? That heliobus's name is Apyra?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Correct. Master Apyra promised to show me the flaws in my swordplay, and how to take it to the next level. That's why I brought them to Dragonprayer Terrace... where I suffered my most serious setback...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Young one, with me, everything will be different.
rows.speaker: Voice From the Sword Formation

rows.text: Whether it be Imbibitor Lunae, the Stellaron Hunters, or that woman, your accomplishments will exceed them. You will be matchless, without limits.
rows.speaker: Voice From the Sword Formation

rows.text: Matchless, without limits...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: You're just in time. The swords have taught me something already... I'd like to see how sharp my skills have become...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Their skills are nothing compared to mine... what can I learn from any of them...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Then why not hack them down right here?
rows.speaker: Voice From the Sword Formation

rows.text: Hack... them down? I thought we were just sparring.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: The laws of the battlefield are no different from the laws of the universe — life for victory and death for defeat. Swordsmanship is the art of victory, and only the victorious swords can be passed on — swords defeated are buried among the barren wastelands.
rows.speaker: Voice From the Sword Formation

rows.text: But...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: You're resisting me? Tsk, rid yourself of these needless notions of clemency. How can you move forward without casting these distractions aside! Raise your sword!
rows.speaker: Voice From the Sword Formation

rows.text: Hmph, "life for victory and death for defeat," huh? All this talk of laws of the battlefield and the universe — you think that gives the appearance of a grand master? You're just using someone else's ambition to satisfy your own desire to shed blood.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: This Xuanyuan Sword in my hand has been passed down through my family for generations. When my mother gave it to me, she said: "The bread may bake, but the hearth remains..." and for a long time I had no idea what she was talking about.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Today I just realized I misheard her. I think she actually said: "The edge may break, but the heart remains..." probably.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Lieutenant Yanqing, the winner and loser of this battle have yet to be determined. Don't give me that "there's no point in fighting any longer" speech!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Hahaha, this little wench's fighting spirit is on fire! Young one, since she insists on fighting, will you give her our answer?
rows.speaker: Voice From the Sword Formation

rows.text: I... I won't back down.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Miss Sushang, you—
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: This is between fellow Cloud Knights. Losing a fight isn't a big deal, but if I abandon my fellow soldiers and bring dishonor to the Knights, how could I wield my sword again?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Granted, I might not last more than a few moves. You guys go get the general — quickly! I'll try and hold him off until he gets here!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Tail possesses the two and tries to bring them back to Huohuo together.
Tail possesses the mean classmate and tries to bring him back to Huohuo.
Let's bring this one back.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tail? How are you... how are you still here? ...I see now... You're leaving me too...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ha!?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Everyone always leaves me... I don't want to be alone, not again...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I haven't left!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Please, Tail, no more words! I can't bear to see you fade away...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Are you a judge or not!? This heliobus is distorting your perceptions! Get a grip! Resist them!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: They've all gone... all abandoned me...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: "All gone"? Just watch me, I'll drag them all back!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Everyone will leave... they always do, eventually...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What about your ghost-hunting buddies?
What about those Ten Lords fogeys?
You have me, don't you?
What about your ghost-hunting buddies?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...They aren't here.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What about those Ten Lords fogeys?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...They aren't here.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You have me, don't you?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Just wait, I'm going to bring everyone here!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: What should I do?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Tail...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Maybe you should take the rest of the people back to Huohuo.
Where... where am I? T—Tail, are you here?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I... I feel like I've been possessed. Tail, is that you?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...No, it can't be him. Tail always said only the most privileged are worthy of being his host.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Stop overthinking, Huohuo. What should I do now?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Huohuo, I'm sorry. It's better that you pretend mom and dad are no longer here...
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: How can your own flesh and blood be so heartless? These humans...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Why does Huohuo get so much attention!? Hmph, I'm gonna get everyone to ignore her...
rows.speaker: Mean Classmate

rows.text: The behavior of these brats is astounding.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You probably won't be able to leave right now if you're possessed.
This tail is just so creepy! It glows like some sort of torch, gross!
rows.speaker: Scared Classmate

rows.text: Hey! Wanna lose a hand!?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tail senses that this door is just an imaginary structure in the Illusory Maze with nothing behind the door.
Tail felt like he could hear the murmurs of a devil, "Tail, you must not go through there. Do not go through there."
Just what lies on the other side of that door? Tail is not prepared for an "equivalent exchange," nor does he plan on going through.
If you see any rare species in the future, remember to tell me about them!
rows.speaker: Lila

rows.text: But I'm still me... I'm the one in control...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Is my sister okay?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm sorry, Huohuo, your father and I had no choice but to send you to the Ten-Lords Commission. It's best if you pretend we never existed...
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: I—I'm not trying to make you feel sorry for me...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You're all so mean...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: We shouldn't be talking to a monster, anyway. Let's get out of here.
rows.speaker: Scared Classmate

rows.text: You know what? They left, let them be. I'm not a people person anyway. Without you, Tail, they'd have left me just the same...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...but you came back for me... and that's all I need.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Well, since you put it like that, I suppose I have nothing to feel guilty about anymore!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Mom?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Is this an illusion? Mom, what are you doing here? I've missed you so much.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: S—Stay back! Don't come any closer!
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: I don't know who you are, but you're not my Huohuo. Keep that filthy thing you're carrying away from me!
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: I—It's just a matter of time before it takes control of you...
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: The farther you stay away from her, the better.
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: Even though she knows this is just a mirage made by the heliobus, Huohuo's breathing still gets heavier after her mother leaves.
Huohuo, look, I brought everyone back for you.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Wh—Who's back?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Huohuo, our precious girl... Mom and dad shouldn't have left you all alone.
rows.speaker: Huohuo's Mother

rows.text: Huohuo, I'm sorry... I was just jealous that your tail is cooler than mine!
rows.speaker: Mean Classmate

rows.text: Huohuo, I've always dreamt about having such a cool tail. Why don't you come play with me?
rows.speaker: Scared Classmate

rows.text: They're only here because you possessed them and made them come back. This isn't what I meant...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh c'mon! You wanted them to return — they returned!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tail... you're not an illusion... You're here! You're actually Tail!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Where have you been all this time? I thought you were already...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Dead? Well, I haven't exactly had a picnic — exploding into countless shards, being your shadow for all those rotten years — it's about time I had some good luck!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I thought about getting out of here, but I couldn't shake the feeling there was something wrong... so I came back to see if you could manage on your own, or if you were still a scaredy-cat.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I'm sorry... I guess I still am...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: No, you're selling yourself short! You're daring! How you had the courage to do something so dangerous amazes me! It's not bravery you lack, but sense!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...What other choice did I have? I suspected that Cirrus was deceiving me, but the thought of losing you forever was... unbearable.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Forget about all that, I'm here now. But... did everyone really leave you because of me?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Somebody needs to keep you out of trouble! Speaking of which, there's a pesky heliobus lurking right here. I'm coming for you!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Don't even think about escaping!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: One hit, one stroke of luck, one victory.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Impressive... I am bested...
rows.speaker: Apyra

rows.text: Phew. It's about time we got this guy into the gourd.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Yo, what's up! You're finally here! Without you, our ghost-hunting squad would be nothing!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Hey, I'm a reliable squad member too!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Sure, when you're not passed out in fear! Hehe...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We have our work cut out for us, that's for sure. Sometimes a lead is obviously fake, but other times... it's hard to tell from just a few words on the Internet.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Madam Hanya has already given us the green light. We'll record our heliobi-hunting expeditions to get more followers, and then use the intel from our followers to find more heliobi. It's like a vicious cycle... W—Wait — a virtuous cycle!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wait, aren't we supposed to be operating in secret?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I can hear laughter, but where's it coming from...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Ugh, now I'm starting to get the heebie jeebies...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: You can say that again...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Cut it out — if you keep teasing me, I—I... I'm not gonna perform my boulder-smashing trick for you anymore!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: What's this ghost-hunting squad all about?
The official name is the "Ten-Lords Commission Special Operations Team for the Heliobi Containment Breach Incident."
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: That was the name given to us by decree of the Ten Lords. Since we managed to survive the Fyxestroll Garden incident, the Ten Lords decided to entrust us with hunting down and subduing the heliobi using our special skills.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Ugh, this tedium... even the insects can't hold my attention any longer. I wonder if these ones will prove to be more entertaining?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Cirrus, we've come to ask you a few questions. I hope you'll be cooperative.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It wasn't your fight to begin with.
Masterstroke them! Please?
What kind of heliobus is Luxie?
Sounds like a childish name for a heliobus.
Sounds like a made-up name to me.
We'll get to it sooner or later.
You wouldn't win anyway.
We have to run some errands first — be patient!

Hello there! Judging by your clothing, you two must be healers from the Alchemy Commission. My name is Sushang — I'm a Cloud Knight Soldier. Are you looking for the Dragon Lady who suddenly disappeared?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Uh... Even the Cloud Knights are getting involved? Did you file a report or something?
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: Report? I haven't said a word to the Realm-Keeping Commission, let alone the Cloud Knights. People would think we were crazy if we reported this... There's something fishy going on — how did the Cloud Knights find out?
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: Uh... Hah, good question! So, actually, we're affiliated with the Ten—
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: The Tenth Squad! Cloud Knight Security Squad Ten, to be precise, hehe... We patrol the streets and respond to all kinds of unexpected incidents! It's grunt work, essentially...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: (Try to open the door.)
(Try to ram the door open)
(Try to kick the door down.)
Doors are my specialty.
Why, how generous of you...
I'm a jack of many trades, but master of none...
I had fun.
I nearly had a heart attack.
Just glad it's all over.
I'm afraid you're overestimating me...
Aren't you the one in charge of social media engagement?
By decree of the Ten Lords?
Using our special skills?
That's right — this expedition was commissioned by the Ten Lords themselves. I am unsure as to why they attached so much importance to this endeavor, but I have a theory.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Huohuo is a judge of the Ten-Lords Commission and I'm a Cloud Knight — we must answer the call to the best of our abilities. And [Trailblazer] is an outworlder who's done great things for the sake of the Xianzhou...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: But why did Little Gui have to get dragged into this? This mission is too dangerous for a civilian!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...I get it. You don't think I have any special skills, so I'll just get in the way?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Every flower and tree on the Xianzhou is significant in its own way — Miss Gui has her own strengths too. As a famous street performer and livestreamer, she has precisely the skills we need to acquire intel for our mission.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Miss Gui has set up a social media account under the guise of investigating paranormal phenomena and unexplained mysteries... we can use it to gather intel for our mission.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: You hear that, Sushang! I'm a key member of the squad! They said I could be a Ten-Lords Commission intelligence hawk!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I don't have any more questions.
Uh... I might not be a scholar, but I don't think calling someone a "hawk" is a compliment.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission has specially entrusted Judge Huohuo with commanding the ghost-hunting squad, so please make sure to follow her lead in all matters related to the heliobi.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: ...Th—That's right. I won't let us down.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Captain Huohuo, should we start the ghost hunt now?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: C—Captain? You can just call me Huohuo.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Understood, Captain Huohuo.
We're all counting on you, Judge Huohuo.
I'm really surprised that Madam Hanya asked me to be the leader of the ghost-hunting squad.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: After Tail disappeared, I thought for sure the Commission would ask me to resign, but for some reason... A—Anyway, I'll do my best to carry out my duties!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Actually, I'm not sure if I can be helpful anymore...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: After Tail disappeared, I thought for sure the Commission would ask me to resign... but for some reason, Madam Hanya asked me to be the leader of the ghost-hunting squad.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: A—Anyway, I'll do my best to carry out my duties!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: As for our mission... Cirrus was locked up in Fyxestroll Garden, but there were a lot of other heliobi that escaped after the Creation Furnace was broken.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: According to the Ten-Lords Commission's understanding of heliobi behavior, they tend to roam densely populated areas in search of hosts... and wherever they go, there are bound to be reports of "supernatural phenomena."
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm really surprised that Madam Hanya asked me to be the leader of the ghost-hunting squad.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Little Gui, can you show us the website we'll be using for intel?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Actually, I'm not sure if I can be helpful anymore...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Lady Bailu disappeared? That's nothing new — she sneaks off all the time.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: That's not the point — here, read this part...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: As for our mission... Cirrus was locked up in Fyxestroll Garden, but there were a lot of other heliobi that escaped after the Creation Furnace was broken.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: "One of the healers from the Alchemy Commission had Lady Bailu cornered, but then she disappeared into thin air..."
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Maybe they were seeing things.
Let's see... Ghast—ly Grayv... ee? Ghastly Gravy!? What kind of website is that?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ugh, it's Ghostly Grove, not Ghastly Gravy!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Ghostly Grove is the most renowned website for paranormal enthusiasts on the Luofu. Everyone who loves the mysterious and the unexplained knows about it.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I used to go there to read first-hand accounts of ghost sightings whenever I needed to build up my courage.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: We can get our leads from this website and then investigate them posing as paranormal investigators.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: That means we can operate more efficiently, and with a low profile... If people started to see a spiritfarer making door-to-door visits, they might begin to panic... and that would give the heliobi even more power over their hosts.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Look, I'm a new user, so I only have a few followers on this site... but based on past experience, once you get a following, people start flooding you with stories and news about paranormal activity.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: What if all the leads we get turn out to be fake?
A lot of paranormal activity is just people in costumes.
We have our work cut out for us, that's for sure. Sometimes a lead is obviously fake, but other times... it's hard to tell from just a few words on the Internet.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: After all, some people will make up all kinds of nonsense to attract attention.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: So we still have to go out and fact-check the leads?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Mm. Plus, the spiritfarers from the Ten-Lords Commission will be carrying out their own investigation in secret as well.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Speaking of attracting attention... how do we get a following on a paranormal activity website? Sounds like Little Gui's department — she used me in some of her performances just to draw a bigger crowd.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: That's the easy part — we just post some videos of us ghost hunting... Uh, I mean, subduing heliobi! We're working for the Ten-Lord's Commission after all — we're gonna have the best content out there!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Will the Ten-Lords agree to this?
Does sound kinda effective...

Madam Hanya has already given us the green light. We'll record our heliobi-hunting expeditions to get more followers, and then use the intel from our followers to find more heliobi. It's like a vicious cycle... W—Wait — a virtuous cycle!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wait, aren't we supposed to be operating in secret?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Another thing we have to think about is that heliobi feed on the emotions of their hosts. They can even manipulate a host into revealing their deepest secrets...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Wouldn't posting a victim's personal information online... cause even more harm to the victim? I—I'm not trying to pick holes... just raising some concerns.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The way I see it, "operating in secret" and "exposing the paranormal" go hand-in-hand.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We won't reveal the names of any victims. We'll just post some pics and videos of the squad engaging in fierce battles with the supernatural! And then come up with some dramatic titles...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Like: "Little Gui Investigates: Ghost Tries to Scare Young Cloud Knight Girl on Creepy Road — Gets Owned..." Y'know?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We'll turn the entire heliobi-hunting process into regular uploads. Viewers will see that there's nothing that scary about it, and there won't be any public panic!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Why are you looking at me? Want a medal or something...? It does kinda sound like a good idea...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Hee-hee, thanks bestie.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I feel like some of you aren't convinced by the whole online ghost-hunting thing... How about this — we take a look at the leads we have so far, and pick one to try out as a test run.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: "When You See It You'll Scream!" That's so cliche, with the arrow and everything... "Failed Your Starskiff Pilot Test? You're Cursed!" Tsk, people are always looking for excuses...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I'm trying to find some interesting leads. You ready to start ghost hunting, or do you wanna chat with the squad first?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Let's hunt some ghosts.
I wanna chat for a bit first.
I found a suspicious report...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Take a look — this post is getting tons of comments.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Oh, if it isn't the little girl who fainted in Fyxestroll Garden the moment she encountered the heliobi? Already talking to me like a detective, are you?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Hey! Where's my sword? Y—You just wait...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Can we destroy Cirrus already?
Don't let them get to you.
Hmph, there are plenty of beings in this garden that would like to kill me... Why don't you line up one-by-one and take turns trying?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: D—Don't be ridiculous... We can't allow the host to be harmed.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Okay, okay... I just wish I could teach them a lesson!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Cirrus... you must be unhappy with how things turned out, right?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What do you want from me, little fox girl? You want to know what happened to the guard dog? He turned to ashes a long time ago!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I... I don't care about that at all... but I can't help but notice — you managed to escape the furnace, and now you're stuck here, unable to move an inch, while the other heliobi are roaming around the Luofu enjoying themselves... Must be quite frustrating.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hahaha... You want me to assist you and betray my own kind?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Cirrus stays silent, sizing everyone up through the eyes of the spiritfarer they possess. Finally, they decide to talk.

...I can do that — under one condition... I wish to arrange a challenge — one akin to the struggle between the great heliobus Ignamar and the general of the Luofu. As long as you can bring me the current general... anything can be negotiated.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The general...?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What, is that too much to ask? It seems the judge here doesn't have what it takes to negotiate with a heliobus!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: That's just another way of saying they don't want to cooperate...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh? Wait, Huohuo, you can't seriously be thinking about—
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Deal! I'll submit a request to the Seat of Divine Foresight.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Oh? What do we have here? A Nameless, a Cloud Knight, a Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission, and a street performer? Quite the group.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Wow, the general recognizes me? I didn't realize I was so famous!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Haha, my retainer, Yanqing, has mentioned you. You are one of the only people on the Luofu that was able to deprive him of his sword.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Huh? Oh! I—I remember... I should apologize — I did a sword-swallowing performance on the spur of the moment, but forgot to return the sword to him when I left the stage...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: So, what wind has brought you to the Seat of Divine Foresight?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Huohuo tells Jing Yuan about the heliobi crisis and Cirrus' demand.

General, we know you have important matters to attend to, and the Ten-Lords Commission shouldn't be bothering you with something as trivial as the heliobi... but if we allow those creatures to roam freely, I'm afraid...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I heard stories of a skirmish between a previous general and a monster of sorts — I'd always assumed they were an old wives' tale. I never imagined the villain of such tales would come to my doorstep seeking revenge. I must say, it seems a bit unfair that I should assume the debt for a conflict I had no involvement in.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Precisely! In principle, the instigator should bear the burden. Still...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It would appear you are eager to see me assume the debt.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General Teng Xiao is a venerated predecessor. If I am to honor his legacy, then sitting idly by is not an option. If an audience with the general of the Luofu is requested, then I will honor such a request.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General, heliobi are vile creatures capable of taking over the bodies of mortals... If you're unsure...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I appreciate the Ten-Lords Commission having such high regard for my welfare. It is true I am rather inexperienced when it comes to heliobi, but as general of the Luofu, I cannot look on while these fugitive creatures wreak havoc on the populace.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I still have some paperwork that needs attending to — once I am finished, I will make my way to Fyxestroll Garden without delay.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: You've lost, Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Hmph, don't get complacent — if I had all of Ignamar's power, I'd never have lost to the likes of you!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Should you decide to try again, my offer still stands... but you must defeat them.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Then what are we waiting for!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Not so fast! Before we fight again, you need to answer one question, like you promised.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Pesky devil of a girl... Alright, what's your question?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Look... is this something a heliobus could have done?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You show Cirrus the post about Bailu's sudden disappearance.

There are countless heliobi that escaped from the Creation Furnace, and every one of them could have done such a thing. It could have been vengeance, curiosity, or simply hunger... So how would I know which one abducted your Dragon Lady?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Of course, I do have my suspicions. For example, Luxie...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Disbelieve it if you like — that's up to you. Unlike humans, I get no joy from telling lies.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Luxie loves mischief. They give no thought to interfering in mortal affairs — their only concerns are entertainment and freedom. Among all the fragments of Ignamar, the one most likely to abduct your precious Dragon Lady... would be Luxie.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: We were sealed away for a thousand years — it's been ages since we last tasted the joys and sorrows of the world of humans. I'm sure Luxie was eager to find a new friend and wander the world with them.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I think they're telling the truth... Heliobi do have different personalities, and they can be influenced by the personality of their host.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: If a heliobus possesses a great warrior, they might gradually take on a braver, fiercer persona... and if their host is a playful child, they may adopt a childlike spirit.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hmm... "wander the world with them." It sounds like Lady Bailu would've been an ideal target — she's always running off to play in Aurum Alley.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Mm... This intel should be a big help.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hey! We're not done here! You still owe me a fight!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You bunch of meat bags! One minor victory and you think you're something special! Come on, show me what you've got!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The clues are all pointing in the same direction now. It would be wise to strike while the iron is hot.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Thank you for your help, general. Let's get going!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ahh, I haven't been here for a while — it's nice to be back in the old stomping ground.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Oh yeah? Since you're so familiar with the place, you can lead the way and conduct the interviews!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Did I hear something from the peanut gallery?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Look! Those two are wearing Alchemy Commission uniforms. They're probably looking for the Dragon Lady...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Lady Bailu disappeared into thin air — they must be pretty confused. Remember, we have to keep our identities secret when we interview them... and don't mention anything about the heliobi — people might start panicking...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Don't worry Judge Huohuo. Effective communication with the public is one of the basic skills of a Cloud Knight~
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I can relate. We're no stranger to grunt work ourselves.
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: Anyway, we heard about the Dragon Lady's disappearance, so we hurried over to see if we could help.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Oh! We know this [Trailblazer] here — {M#he's}{F#she's} from the Astral Express. I've heard the Dragon Lady mention {M#him}{F#her} before.
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: She and I are best buddies.
Am I that famous?
That's right, I'm her long-term meal ticket!
Psst, be normal!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Well, it's great that you all are willing to help. But we haven't actually figured it out what exactly is going on...
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: Uh yeah, just when we had her cornered, the Dragon Lady disappeared with a "bang."
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: And while we were chasing her, we saw two of her! It really is a mystery.
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: It must be cloudhymn magic.
Maybe you were experiencing double vision?
That's what I was just saying! ...But can cloudhymn magic really do that?
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: It sure can! This foxian beside me... well, she's actually the Xianzhou's top expert on intangible cultural heritage — she's super knowledgeable about cloudhymn magic. Huohuo, could you share some expert insight with us?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh? Umm... Ah, yes! I—I'm a very professional expert... and I'd be happy to share my expert knowledge! In fact, Cloudhymn magic isn't the only magic out there that can achieve such feats — we foxians can use our foxfire to make ourselves invisible!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm not even 500 years old yet! My eyes are as sharp as they come!
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: Hmm, maybe you're overworked. Alchemy Commission healers are saving people 24/7 — I'd start seeing things too if I were that busy. As the face of medicinal mastery on the Xianzhou, you two need to be living healthier lifestyles.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh, you really get what we're up against... After this is behind us, I say we take a holiday and get rested up.
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: So where did you last see Lady Bailu?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: On that road there... and I swear I can hear a child giggling whenever I walk by. Must be the wind...
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: You're just hearing things. That red-haired girl is right — we're overworked to the point of exhaustion.
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: Be sure to get some rest! We'll take over from here. Lady Bailu must have seen you and gone off to hide... but with her old friend [Trailblazer] here, maybe she'll be willing to come back out.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Fantastic. Well, we'll leave you to it.
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: Lady Bailu! Lady Bailu, where are you?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Lady Bailu, come out and play with us!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...Wh—Why are there two of her?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: They're asking us to play with them!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Silly-head, they're trying to trick you! They're just gonna catch you and take you back!
rows.speaker: Pseudo-Bailu

rows.text: I know! Let's play a game called "don't let anyone catch us!"
rows.speaker: Pseudo-Bailu

rows.text: Run!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Ghoooooooost!!!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Seriously...? That ghost twin was one thing, but your screaming nearly sent me to the grave...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Ah, sorry! But seriously — I knew it was a heliobus, but seeing double Bailu like that sent shivers down my spine!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I—It's okay, Miss. Sushang... I've worked in the Ten-Lords Commission for many years now, but I'm still not used to their tricks...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: How do we catch them now?
They're eluding our senses, but they won't have gone far... We just need to look around.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It seems to be coming from this room. I'll open the door and take a look. Everyone, stay on high alert.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh? It won't open.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: You try to open the door but it won't budge.
You try to ram the door open but it won't budge.
You try to kick the door open, but it won't budge, and your feet hurt.
Strange... Is this also the work of the heliobus?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: They must know that we're following... but now that we know its hiding spot, it's time to use this.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: This is the Harmonic Chime. It's an item that the Ten-Lords Commission forged to help deal with the heliobi after the Fyxestroll Garden incident.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Heliobi create illusions to isolate their victims... but if we ring this chime, our thought-waves will synchronize with those of the heliobus. As for how it works... I'm afraid that would take the rest of the day to explain.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: In other words, we'll be able to enter the heliobus's illusion?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Exactly... but once we're inside the illusion, we'll still have to figure out a way to catch Luxie.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you're the powerhouse of this team, we'll leave the door to you.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Mm... please be careful.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Mm... be careful not to hurt yourself.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Come on, you're too modest for your own good.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: When you're ready, ring the chime — we'll all charge in together.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: (Ring the chime)
I need a moment to get ready.
Don't wait too long. They might make a run for it before we get there.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Truth be told... Luxie didn't seem as evil as the other heliobi we've seen.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: They sure made us run, though. If I ever have to run like that again on the job, I'm filing for worker's comp.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Heliobi don't really fall under "good" or "evil" — they just act according to their desires and emotions. I hope the others will be just as easy to subdue.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I should go surrender myself to those two medics — they were looking so hard to find me...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Wait!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh? What is it?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: We're going to make a post about this "paranormal incident" online to attract more followers — it'll help us get more intel.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: You tell Bailu about the website Ghostly Grove
Oh, I get it... We can't just tell the public that the Dragon Lady was possessed by a heliobus, right? So... we won't mention my name right? And we'll make up a headline?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: That's right, we wanna report this incident like it's a paranormal phenomenon — the more exaggerated the better — and then announce that it was solved by our ghost-hunting squad! Then we add on a few photos and videos — it'll be sure to get lots of views!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Um... That's great and all, but I'm not good at making stuff up on the spot...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: [Trailblazer] I heard that you helped Mr. Xiyan write stories before — you must be an expert wordsmith!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: It's all a team effort. Come on, help me think of something!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Hmmm... I say that's a good title. What does everyone think? Alrighty then, it's decided.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: You should go back soon, Lady Bailu. Those two medics have had a rough day.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Okay, I'm going back now. Thanks for the rescue~
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Case closed! I never knew catching heliobi would require so much work...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: We're not done yet... Madam Hanya said that once we've subdued a heliobus, we should return to Fyxestroll Garden and lock them inside one of the Evil Binding Matrix's suppression towers.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm not sure how the online community will react, but you can bet the Ghostly Grove will be the talk of the town sooner or later.
Expel evil and capture stray spirits... With the support of the Ten-Lords Commission's spiritfarers, you seal the heliobus within the Lunaumbra Gourd.
It's over! Whew... Now I can finally get some rest.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: But there are still lots of heliobi roaming around out there... we can't rest for too long.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Let tomorrow worry about tomorrow.
I couldn't agree more.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ooooh⁓! Our follower count has skyrocketed!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: And as predicted, we got some new leads... Looks like my strategy is working like a treat!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: When everyone's rested and ready, let's go through the leads. Time to find another heliobus.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I'd rather focus on resting first... I need to wait for my heart rate to recover before I go chasing another heliobus.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: After the ghost-hunting squad disbanded, the chat starts to flash with activity...
This boredom is killing me... the only entertainment I have around here is watching the insects fly by.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Speaking of which, it seems one of them has come to visit me. I wonder, is {F#she}{M#he} here to taunt me, or implement some sort of restorative justice? We'll just have to wait and see...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Still haven't given up?
What are your terms of surrender?
I'm speechless.
The Ten-Lords Commission judges won't abandon one of their own... but they won't let me off the hook either.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: So now I'm stuck here, condemned to eternal boredom. Hehe, I wonder which will last longer — the lifespan of my jailors, or the patience of a heliobus...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: In any case, time is on my side, so long as the Xianzhou are willing to maintain some facade of humanity.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Surrender? Why would I do that? To you, I may as well be fighting an unwinnable battle — wasting my time away in someone else's body...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...but for me, the game has only just begun. The Ten-Lords Commission doesn't have any moves left... and I still have time to turn the game in my favor.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You know, it wasn't that long ago that you and those judges would have become my pawns — if it wasn't for that meddling guard dog...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: If you have nothing to say, then run along and let me be.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], it is good to see you are doing well.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Maybe they made it up.
Judging from the comments, there were several witnesses. Sure, Lady Bailu runs away all the time, but disappearing into thin air?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: It looks like the work of a heliobus... The heliobi are masters of manipulating the senses. There are stories of heliobi changing their shape and appearance to disguise themselves as someone else.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Okay, so what are we waiting for? Let's get moving and see if we can find some witnesses.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Before we head out, let's make sure we have our intel in order.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: If we can better understand what a heliobus wants to do — and what it's capable of doing — it'll be easier for us to help the victim.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Interviewing witnesses might give us some clues, but they won't know anything about heliobi. I... I think I have an idea... We have another source of intel we could use...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: You mean... Cirrus?
Why would Cirrus help us?
That's right! Those heliobi were locked up in the same space for ages! They probably got to know their fellow prisoners like the back of their... Huh, I guess they don't really have hands...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I heard from Miss Hanya that Cirrus is caught in a stalemate — the Evil Binding Matrix has trapped them. Will they really cooperate with us?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Th—The thought of seeing Cirrus sends shivers down my spine... but I bet Cirrus would be eager to see me again... they'd devour me whole if they could.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Little Gui's methods can be a little unorthodox, but that's just because she has a vivid imagination... When it comes to getting things done, she's actually pretty reliable.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Why did you suddenly feel the need to say that?
Haha, I'm worried you don't trust her plan. Just relax — Little Gui is unbeatable in her area of expertise.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You two seem to have a lot of history.
You two sure like getting each other into trouble...
That's just the sticky glop that holds friends together!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...Glue.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Like the time Guinaifen dragged me to Fyxestroll Garden so I could protect her, but I was so scared I ended up fainting...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: While I was passed out, she went and caused all kinds of trouble... I neglected my duty of keeping her from making a mess of things.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: But I'll redeem myself this time! I'll make sure to protect her— uh, and also keep an eye on her...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: That being said, why did you decide to come back into this mess? Dealing with heliobi isn't an easy task...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I'm not sure I was given the choice...
I have a score to settle with Cirrus...
You come for me, you best not miss.
Hahahaha, oh yeah! No one asked you if you wanted to join the ghost hunting squad — we just took you in by default.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Sure you don't wanna reconsider? It's not too late to change your mind!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Well, since I'm already here...
Good point! May as well see it through!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Oh, that's right, you were possessed by a heliobus once before — guess it wasn't a pleasant experience, was it?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It was too short — I want to try it again.
Not great.
I'M TAINTED!
C'mon, don't act tough.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I'll bet, poor you... This time we're gonna avenge you! I'll show those heliobi what happens when they mess with my friend!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ah! Can you not do that...? Don't worry, this time we're gonna avenge you! I'll show those heliobi what happens when they mess with my friend!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: What are you, a mob boss?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You're brave, I'll give you that... Just seeing a heliobus makes me weak in the knees. You... won't laugh at me if I faint, right?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ugh, I can't stand the thought of those things roaming free. After what Little Gui and I went through, I'm not about to let them have their ghostly way.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: [Trailblazer], do you think we can really catch heliobi this way?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The Internet is a very powerful tool.
We'll be trusting random strangers...
Let's feel it out.
I sure hope so...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: That's what I'm worried about too — doesn't feel very reliable...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I guess we have to give it a go... I don't see any other options.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I can't help thinking that if Tail is out there, there'll be traces of him on the Internet. He had a big personality...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Do you want Tail back?
Yes... Do you think I'm just getting myself into more trouble? It's not like we were good friends to begin with...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...but when Tail disappeared, my tail — my real tail... it disappeared too. Now my reflection looks weird to me, and I hate work even more than before...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...M—Maybe that's all just a bunch of excuses... The truth is... I miss him.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: We'll find him.
He might not be around anymore.
Thank you... if we're ever going to find Tail, now's the best chance we have.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Mm... I guess so. Maybe he ran away, or broke into tiny pieces... Either way, I'd like to know what happened to him.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: O—Of course, finding Tail isn't our top priority right now — we need to catch and subdue all the fleeing escaped heliobi as soon as possible.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: During the Fyxestroll Garden incident, my sister gave the order to seek reinforcements. It was thanks to your support in that critical moment that we were able to get the situation under control. I wanted to thank you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: And now this small team needs your help, too.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Where's Xueyi?
Can we really handle this better than the Ten-Lords Commission?
Is it true that the Ten-Lords Commission is located in... the netherworld?
About Huohuo and Tail...
She sustained heavy injuries in the previous incident.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Fortunately, my sister is using an ingenium body. As long as she returns to the coffin and is tended to by the spiritfarers, her life is not in jeopardy. I still worry about her, though.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Creatures of flesh and blood fear death and will always strive to preserve their life... but not my sister. Her human instinct for survival is slipping away — she sees herself more as a "tool," driving her body to the point of total exhaustion.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Every time she fights like that, I can't bear to watch.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: In most matters, I would say no. But when dealing with heliobi... I think the answer is quite clear.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission have long specialized in suppressing abominations, but they were negligent in guarding against the dangers of the Creation Furnace. Once it became a problem, the spiritfarers and aurumatons were powerless against the heliobi, proving that the traditional means of subduing them were no longer effective.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: As fate would have it, the girl we unwittingly rescued many years ago became the key to defeating Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: After this is all settled, we intend to make contact with the Xianzhou Zhuming. That ship is under the influence of the mythical Reignbow Arbiter — the people there are able to coexist with the heliobi and at the same time be free from their manipulation. We hope that from them we can learn the art of breaking free from the influence of the heliobi.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Did you really think we were messengers from another plane visiting the world of the living? Hehe, how cute of you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: And maybe we are... don't get too close, or you might turn into a ghost too.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The precise location of the Ten-Lords Commission is highly confidential... but you have contributed much to the Xianzhou and are very close to the secret. If you wish to know more about it, I will have to ask you to spend time with our ghost-hunting squad.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: A judge of the Ten-Lords Commission has no past. Once one has entered the service of the commission, all links with the outside world are severed...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: However, since you are now a member of the squad, and in the interest of everyone working together, it's best that we know each other a little better... — I'll tell you some of the secrets I know.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: After Ignamar was defeated by the general in a great battle, the Ten-Lords Commission was ordered to seal away the heliobi fragments. To make them atone for their actions, most of the heliobi were sealed inside the Creation Furnace.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Decades ago, the Ten-Lords Commission was asked to investigate an unusual case — a foxian girl's tail had been consumed by a strange fire of unknown origin... so we set out, ready to subdue whatever foul demon awaited us.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: It turned out that the fire was none other than a heliobus. The remaining fragments of Ignamar — the heliobi — had found some way to escape from their furnace prison.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: That heliobus's power was weakened to the brink of death, but he was kept alive thanks to the kindness of the foxian girl. Gradually, he regained his strength and rekindled his desire to manipulate humans.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Are you done running around yet?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Not quite.
I'm just stopping by to say hi.
Miss us?
Hah, spare me! Have you forgotten that I once controlled you like a puppet?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I provided you with information as promised — why am I still empty-handed?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Tsk, don't bother me again until you're ready to fight!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You'll be begging for a rematch later... just you wait.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The heliobi are like a flame that burns eternal, with no need for sustenance. But alas, their curiosity got the best of them, and they became prisoners of humans. It is a pity.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Do you sympathize with them?
Aren't you afraid we'll be defeated by them...
Why is Cirrus so obsessed with fighting the general of the Luofu?
You're not going back to the Seat of Divine Foresight?
...I lament that we share the same weaknesses.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Our situation is no different from that of the heliobi. From the moment we gain sentience, we are driven by desire and instinct, bound to our destiny, moving unceasingly towards our own demise.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The most important thing in a soldier is one's intuition for victory or defeat. And you have given me confidence in victory.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The ancient legends recount that the Xianzhou once faced an invasion by a great enemy that threatened the annihilation of every race aboard the Xianzhou ships. In order to save the Alliance, a hero made a pact with the Flint Emperor — the predecessor of all heliobi.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Flint Emperor would aid the Xianzhou in battle, and if they were victorious, the hero and their followers would lose their physical bodies for eternity.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: When the fighting had ceased, none of the heroes survived, and the Flint Emperor was gravely wounded. Thus, the pact was unable to be fulfilled. As the centuries came and went, the story faded from memory. But the heliobi remember.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: They hold claim to this debt for all time. The great battle between General Teng Xiao and Ignamar was fought largely for this reason.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Aiding the Ten-Lords Commission in subduing the heliobi is a legitimate reason to take a leave of absence.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I shall treat it as a vacation and enjoy the scenery of Fyxestroll Garden — though I must admit, the wind here does chill the bones.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: *sigh* Why does the Dragon Lady always have to run off... I swear they should be paying us extra for this...
rows.speaker: Young Medic

rows.text: Hah! I should get worker's comp for listening to you complaining all day. If you don't like the work, you can always transfer to the military.
rows.speaker: Experienced Medic

rows.text: Normally, I would have just purged the heliobus and sent it back into the furnace. But Huohuo's body was too frail and weak to perform a purging. The best I could do without harming her was to inscribe a talisman seal — enough to subdue the thing living inside her, at least for a while.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission took Huohuo in as a spiritfarer apprentice, teaching her the arts of purgation and ghost hunting. This way the Commission could keep an eye on Huohuo — and ensure that she wasn't taken over by the heliobus.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: But Tail doesn't seem like an enemy.
Tail betrayed his own kind.

Perhaps all those long years with Huohuo have bestowed upon that heliobus some form of human compassion. Though Tail has never given up on attempting to break free of his bonds or usurping his host, he has fought against his own kind to protect Huohuo.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: You could say that. Who would have thought Tail would have sacrificed himself to defeat Cirrus? Granted, heliobi have no obligation to be loyal to one another, but Tail's willingness to side with Huohuo is significant.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: This has to be the strangest group of people on the Xianzhou...
I would save the jokes for later! As the saying goes, with great work comes great rewards. The Ten-Lords Commission will compensate you accordingly.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I've wondered at times what the Luofu should give the Nameless in return for their great deeds...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Alas, questions like that are above my pay grade. That is for the Ten Lords and the General to figure out.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I leave the matters of the ghost-hunting squad in your hands. If you have further questions, just ask Huohuo.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: As always, I have mountains of paperwork to finish... Piles of paper... I'll never get it all done...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Cirrus, we have brought you the person you wish to see. This is General Jing Yuan, the one who now sits at the Seat of Divine Foresight.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: That's right! For us, any problem that can be solved by force isn't a problem at all.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...So I only need to beat your pawns here?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: We'll be fine! For us, any problem that can be solved by force isn't a problem at all.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Why is the general putting his trust in us? I'm too young to die!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I have never seen this one before... Human, who are you?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Heliobus, is it not your deepest wish to hold a rematch with the general of the Luofu? I have come to grant you an audience.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...This is the current general of the Luofu?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Look at that expression — he's barely half-awake! Where is General Teng Xiao? Why did he choose such a lightweight to take over for him? I suppose it's already too late for the Xianzhou to rid themselves of this clown...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Very well then, General Jing Yuan — how about we settle our score right here in Fyxestroll Garden? If I win, I must be free to come and go as I please...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I agreed to grant you an audience, not meet you in combat.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...What? You refuse? You won't fight me!?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: He comes here after I demand a rematch, and won't even fight... Is he conceding that I already won? No, there can be no victory in eschewing combat — human logic negates it...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You misunderstand — I came for a rematch. It's just that... you are not a worthy opponent.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: WHAT!? UNWORTHY!?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Teng Xiao, as general of the Luofu, was commander-in-chief of the Cloud Knights. Ignamar commanded the heliobi. The two were as great as the sky and the earth — equally matched like yin and yang. It is only natural that they were worthy opponents.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As it stands, I am the general of the Luofu... but you are no Ignamar. Merely a prisoner. If you wish to engage me in battle, you must follow my rules. Defeat my army — only then will I grant you the fight you seek.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...Your army?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: That's right. You must defeat my four companions gathered here — then you will have proved yourself a worthy opponent.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Wait... he means us!? W—W—W—We'll be okay, right?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It would serve you well not to underestimate them. They are as skilled in combat as they are tenacious in spirit. I worry they might pose a problem for you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: If you win, you can have your rematch. If you lose, you will answer one question of their choice — no lies, no tricks. Can you accept these terms?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It's a deal! The game is set — this platform will be our chessboard, and the fighters will be the pieces!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Looks like we're the only ones in good spirits today...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Yo, why the exhaustion? You look like the officers over at the Realm-Keeping Commission.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I don't think that was included in the job posting. Actually, I don't think there ever was a job posting.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I'm sleepy... Little Gui, what kind of magical elixir did you take to make you so energetic?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: A certain Celestial Jade-playing Divination Commission employee, perhaps...?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: That's the Celestial Jade player over at Exalting Sanctum! Whenever I pass through on official business, I always see her with loads of other players.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Who is this, exactly?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It's this girl. Here, look at this post.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: What's going on...
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: [Trailblazer], s—stay close to me, okay? I'm... I'm a little scared...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: So, you imprisoned Luxie in the matrix... and I heard the cries of other heliobi longing to break free.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: It would seem the Ten-Lords Commission has everything under control... What is it you want from me?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Same old same old.
Destiny... is pre-ordained.
Destiny... is not pre-ordained.
Oh, you're here! Is that a Ten-Lords Commission judge?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: What's the situation inside?
Something's amiss in the Divination Commission — everyone is mumbling to themselves. Is this some workforce overhaul? Did I set a bad example?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: At least no one else got hurt.
Don't worry, Qingque's the only witness in the Commission.
Did you hear about the Master Diviner?
What do you think about destiny?
I'm heading off.
Compensation without labor?
Living high on public expense?
Too much of a good thing?
Just came to vent some anger.
We miss you.
Outside the confines of our agreement, you would be unwise to attack.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You have managed to disgust me still further...
rows.speaker: Cirrus
