rows.text: One victory equals one question... don't forget the agreement you made with the general.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Don't be so sure of victory before the battle begins, young one. Without Tail to protect you, isn't subduing a heliobus a bit overwhelming for you?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You know, if you can accept me with an open heart... I can take his place and help you.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: ...R—Really?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I feel... like I've been drained of my strength...
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: Mr. Cloud Knight sir, are you okay? Can you answer a few questions for me? Do you remember what happened to you?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I... I think so... Let me think for a moment...
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: I received a report today about an infestation of abominations here at the Alchemy Commission — the captain sent me to clear it out. What happened after that was like a dream... I can't explain it.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: My weapon suddenly started talking to me... it taught me fighting techniques — which moves to avoid, which moves to use, which stances to adopt to retain balance... then it told me to relax and let it take control against the enemy.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: That sounds just like... a heliobus!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I followed its instructions... To my surprise, it felt like my combat skills had greatly improved. Still, it told me I was incompetent, like a piece of rotten wood. It wanted to find a new apprentice to carry forward the art.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: It was only then that I realized — there was a sword-wielding child beside me, staring right at me.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: Lots of children grow up learning to use a sword on the Luofu, but for a child to be walking around with one...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...I sure hope we're not thinking of the same person.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I realized the boy was the General's retainer, Yanqing.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: I knew it...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: When I heard my sword say the name, I was in disbelief... and then, for some reason, I just... attacked Yanqing.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: Are YOU alright? You should be asking the Cloud Knight.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Yes, I'm fine. The funny thing is that I didn't even see him move — I just fell straight to the ground.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: He must have spared me. The funny thing is that I didn't even see him move — I just fell straight to the ground.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: What happened next was even more outlandish — Yanqing looked like he was talking to the sword in his hand. He turned around and left without looking back. And my weapon... my weapon never spoke again.
rows.speaker: Delirious Cloud Knight

rows.text: Not good!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I'll take care of the Cloud Knight. You go after Yanqing!
rows.speaker: Vigilant Cloud Knight

rows.text: It's Yanqing's sword — I saw him wield it one time when I was doing drills with the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I heard that Yanqing's sword is a famous weapon crafted by the Artisanship Commission. It resonates with its master — reacting to his movements in battle like it has a mind of its own.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: He must have encountered some kind of danger... and his sword flew away to find someone to help, right?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: D—Danger...? Miss Sushang, don't scare me like that — what kind of evil would be strong enough to pose a threat to Yanqing?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I'm not sure, but the heliobi are strange creatures — even the sharpest sword can't cut them.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Uh-oh. I just had a thought...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: If it's not auspicious, you'd best not say it out loud!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Based on what that Cloud Knight said, it isn't that Yanqing's in danger...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: It's that we're in danger?
It's that Yanqing has become the danger?
Exactly.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Follow the sword. No matter what, we have to find Yanqing before things get even worse.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: The body of an abomination, with only a single sword cut on it.
We've got to catch up with him before things get out of hand.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: The waves ride on the howling wind, bashing the ford with great intensity.
Yanqing's sword hangs in the air, pointing to the distance across the Lunarescent Depths.
This is the dock for Dragonprayer Terrace. Judging by the sword's behavior... that's where Yanqing is.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Should we really be charging over there? Even without a heliobus, Yanqing is a swordsmaster among swordsmasters.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: A—Are you scared, Sushang? Me too... Compared to the other heliobi we've dealt with so far, this one seems like it could do some serious damage.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Scared? Hmph! My mother taught me swordplay as soon as I could walk. I might not be as good as the general's apprentice, but I would never let cowardice dishonor the name of the Cloud Knights or the family sword...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...but I am worried... If the heliobus possessing Yanqing is too strong, I'm afraid I might not be able to guarantee everyone's safety.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: The General has been supporting our ghost-hunting squad from the very beginning — it's time to return the favor.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Even if it wasn't for the general's sake, as a judge, I can't let a heliobus take over someone as dangerous as Yanqing.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Sushang, Miss Gui, [Trailblazer], please help me rescue him.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Yanqing is at Dragonprayer Terrace. [Trailblazer], let's go.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Let's catch a ferry and head for Dragonprayer Terrace.
Let me get ready first...
Sushang, my bestie... why is she so stubborn...?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Still, that was pretty freaking cool...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: A spiritfarer told me that the General is still in Fyxestroll Garden — let's hurry!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I think the only one that can break Yanqing's illusion is Jing Yuan himself...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: [Trailblazer], is something the matter? You seem out of breath.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: You tell Jing Yuan what happened on Dragonprayer Terrace.

A heliobus that creates illusions for the sole purpose of instructing someone in swordplay? I wouldn't mind learning a few tricks from them myself... Unfortunately, it sounds like this one is a little too aggressive to be a decent sparring partner. This is not an adversary that someone as young as Yanqing is equipped to deal with.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General, we need to move fast — if we wait any longer, I'm afraid that Sushang might be—
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: I can understand your sense of urgency. But before I leave, I have a question for Cirrus, who has been listening this whole time — I trust you are familiar with Apyra...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Naturally. Among the heliobi, Apyra manifests the courage and warring spirit of Ignamar — they are the most aggressive of all the fragments... but who is this swordmaster? Who is Yanqing?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: My apprentice.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Hee-hee, no wonder I smell a hint of sadness in you... In order to rescue his incompetent apprentice, the master must fight on the battlefield himself? I must say, I'm very envious of Apyra...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You know the flavor of sadness, but not its meaning. An apprentice obsessed with victory and defeat has lost his mind to a heliobus, and is now trying to shortcut his way to mastery of the sword. This is my failure to him as a master, and the source of the grief you see in me now.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Then you should hurry — Apyra has an insatiable bloodlust. Once they've enslaved your mind, they can make you turn against your friends, your kin... even your own master.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Go. I don't wish to delay your deathmatch with your apprentice.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Sushang is awaiting our timely arrival at Dragonprayer Terrace. [Trailblazer], let's go.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Dragonprayer Terrace it is...
Let me get ready first...
Expel evil and capture stray spirits... With the support of the Ten-Lords Commission's spiritfarers, you seal the heliobus within the Lunaumbra Gourd.
Phew, th—that was a big risk, Miss Sushang...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Actually, I'm well aware of my own limits. If it weren't for Yanqing resisting that heliobus, maybe I wouldn't have been able to hold on until you brought reinforcements.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...Why did it take three people to get reinforcements?
...Was it crucial for ALL of us to retreat?
Come to think of it... we only needed one person to fetch reinforcements... Why didn't we get [Trailblazer] to stay behind with you...? And why didn't you ask!?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Hehe, it's kinda embarassing but... I was caught up in the moment — I guess I never thought it through...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Sometimes I wonder whether your head's screwed on right. We need to take you to the Alchemy Commission for a check-up.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Maybe, but my actions kept everyone safe, and that's what matters! Miss Huohuo needed someone to look out for her, and Little Gui is just a civilian — you shouldn't be putting yourself in risky situations. As for [Trailblazer], {M#he's}{F#she's} a distinguished guest of the Seat of Divine Foresight — if anything were to happen to {M#him}{F#her}, it could turn into a diplomatic crisis.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: After weighing things up in my head, it made the most sense for only me to stay put.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I—If I still had my tail... I wouldn't be slowing everyone down...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Sorry Huohuo, I didn't think it through. You were never a burden.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It's not your fault Miss Sushang, it's just... I've been wondering — how can someone average like me keep up with the affairs of the Ten-Lords Commission without my tail?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: ...Forget it. We should get some rest — there could be even bigger dangers waiting for us tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Then... to the rest of you, thank you — for bringing me out of that daze... Especially you, Miss Sushang.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Why does everyone that gets "heliobused" love to apologize for it? You're the victim here. They're the ones stirring up chaos.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It should be me thanking you for holding back during our battle...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Or maybe, just maybe, it's due to a sudden skill improvement? Don't you think?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: When you're not passed out in fear, you're pretty good.
A little pleased with yourself, aren't you...?
Haha, right — conscious Sushang is pretty badass.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: She went toe-to-toe with the general's star pupil! I'd be pretty pleased with myself, too.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: We're gonna need to get you a front page news story for this one. Heck, let's get some billboards!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: So you've made it your daily mission to tease me, huh?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: With respect to this incident, what is your plan for posting on the Luofu's Ghostly Grove? Since it concerns the Seat of Divine Foresight, I am hoping you could...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Well, about that... let me discuss it with [Trailblazer] first.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...Is everyone okay with this?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Thanks for covering for me... I'm so embarrassed.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: All's well that ends well. We should hurry back and lock Apyra in the Evil Binding Matrix... They're a dangerous one — I'm afraid they might escape!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Well then, Yanqing and I will take our leave now.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Alright, let's get out of here!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Come to laugh at me again, have you, little brat?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I'm not in the mood for your chatter — go away!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: We don't have time for that. Even if Cirrus does know something, by the time we've finished asking questions, it'll be too late!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I'm looking at the reply — see, here. Miss Hanya said she's on her way.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Time to give this heedless creature a reality check!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: It's all up to you now, Tail!
Wait a minute, I'm still not ready.
It's exorcism o'clock!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Not ready? I'm the one doing the possessing here!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Ugh... Fine. As a courtesy, I'll wait. Tell me when you're ready.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Cirrus's will to fight has been shattered — they can no longer pose a threat. Considering that everything here is now under control, I'll take my leave.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Thanks for stepping in, General.
My masterstroke wasn't that bad after all?
I merely fulfilled my duty, and kept my promise to Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Not at all. You have been of great assistance these past days, and for that I express my gratitude.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: But the heliobus we dealt with will not be easily dismissed. Given sufficient time, and regardless of how slim the odds are, they will someday break the seal that binds them. However, that concern will fall to the generals of the future.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: One cannot help but wonder how many Luofu generals this fragment of Ignamar will face in times to come. Speaking purely from the perspective of a warrior, I must say I feel somewhat envious.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The heliobi's objective is pretty simple, don't you think?
It would've been easier if you'd stepped in from the start...
That it may be, but they cause no shortage of trouble. Perhaps I could glean some wisdom from the Xianzhou Zhuming...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: In my estimation, this heliobus was not an overwhelming problem for you. Besides, each of you has appeared to gain something from this series of events.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: This excursion was not an official matter — I didn't report it to the counselors. What remains of it will be left to the Ten-Lords Commission, and once matters have concluded, I believe everyone present will be duly rewarded.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: And as for you and the young Miss Guinaifen, rest assured you won't be short-changed. You see? Helping the general of the Luofu does have its perks. It's time I took my leave. Farewell.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Come to laugh at me again, have you, little brat?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I'm not in the mood for your chatter — go away!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: It appears we are all present. The spiritfarers who were supposed to report to Huohuo mentioned they didn't see her today.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I'll get straight to the point — I have no idea where Huohuo may be. However, if we combine our efforts we may be able to piece together some clues. Each of you are close to Huohuo, did you notice anything unusual about her yesterday?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yeah, Miss Huohuo has been trying to track down Tail — in addition to helping the squad, that is.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: She's been down in the dumps ever since she lost Tail.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Since becoming a judge, Huohuo has often thought about resigning. She thinks she might not be cut out for the task.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: After working together for the last few days, it is clear that Huohuo has already formed a close bond with each of you. It is hard for me to imagine she would simply wander off on her own... Unless someone deceived her...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: If you ask me, after she lost Tail, I think her urge to resign became even more apparent.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: What if Huohuo came across a lead today — something that sounded like Tail's doing...? Knowing her, she's probably gone looking for him...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission might not be able to completely eradicate the heliobi, but we have plenty of ways of dealing with them...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Aw, does it hurt? You'll be pleased to know I didn't drag out the suffering. I told her that her Tail was hiding in Cloudford — preparing to flee the Xianzhou on a starskiff.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I started feeling sorry for her. Out of pity I told her that her Tail was hiding in Cloudford — preparing to flee the Xianzhou on a starskiff.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I also told her that the Ten-Lords Commission was in the process of recapturing all the heliobi. If she were to turn to you for help, "Mr. Tail" would be imprisoned — even if she managed to find him. Looks like she took the bait...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I tricked you, didn't I?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You should have faith in your friend... Perhaps Huohuo is safe and sound — perhaps she's managed to subdue the heliobi? If you rush to Cloudford, there's still a chance you might find her...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Huohuo spent a long time in coexistence with a heliobus — it is likely she became accustomed to that state. With Tail now gone, she was relatively defenseless against other heliobi.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: This isn't just a heliobus illusion, it's a complete sensory barrier — cutting off the individual from the outside world. In this case, even the Harmonic Chime won't work.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: This isn't something the healers at the Alchemy Commission can handle. I'll take Huohuo back to the Ten-Lords Commission — perhaps they'll have an answer.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: We are not completely out of options.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yeah, Cirrus is bound to know what this heliobus is up to.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Cirrus may come across as hot-headed and impulsive, but under the surface they are actually full of guile...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: ...It's not because of me, is it?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: It looks like the "endgame" that General Jing Yuan has been trying to avoid is fast approaching. Sushang, please head to the Seat of Divine Foresight and fetch the general.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: What do you know? This is between me and the Ten-Lords Commission — a non-aggression pact, if you like.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: If I were merely Starfire Essence, then naturally I'd prefer to glide through the cosmos... but after being entangled in your human world, my freedom is no longer that simple.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Mm... According to the Ten Lords, Tail must be supervised by a judge... I'll make sure to take good care of Mr. Tail.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: What could be more important than protecting the Xianzhou from the threat of heliobi?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You sound just like her...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Haha, quit worrying Sushang, you've been an awesome squad member! And a very talented sleepyhead.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: ...And yet she didn't come to any of us for help. That's not like her.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Given the type of person she is, if she did have any clues, she would seek out our help. If she hasn't shared anything with us, it means there is only one possibility.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Correct. And I think I might know who the culprit is.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Right, maybe someone deceived her with news about Tail — told her "she could only go alone." Sounds like a trick some nasty kidnapper would use.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Cirrus... The only one who may have knowledge of Tail's whereabouts is Cirrus... whose plans were foiled due to Tail's actions.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Even if Cirrus doesn't know where Tail is, given the shared history, they wouldn't hesitate to cause trouble...
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Let's go, we must try to squeeze some answers out of Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Well, well, insects who don't know when to quit. I sense you have questions... Go on, ask away.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Huohuo is missing, and I'm willing to bet you know something about it!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: How careless... Your companion vanishes right under your noses, and you fail to notice. Why am I the one you're pestering?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Ooh, how threatening, hehe... Save your breath, I know your tactics.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Let's cut to the chase. I do know something about it.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I knew it!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Believe it or not, while you were distracted, she came and found me. She asked me if I knew where "Mr. Tail" was, and I simply gave her a clue...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: She searched high and low, but came back empty-handed, of course. If only you could have seen her expression — simultaneously terrified and desperate to know more — utterly hilarious!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: In the end, I became fed up with her constant nagging. I told her that her beloved Tail had splintered and been reduced to an ember without a single memory... You should've seen her face!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Lies! You can't possibly know where Tail disappeared to!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Maybe I do, maybe I don't. But I have no doubt about one thing: My friends are ready and waiting for her in Cloudford!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Not good! Sushang, [Trailblazer], let's head to Cloudford, quickly!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: The paperwork will have to wait. I'm coming with you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Huohuo, you're awake! Seems like Tail's "operation" was a success!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Huh... Madam Hanya, Miss Gui, Sushang, and {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Thank you, all of you. Are you the ones who brought Tail back?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Well, where would we be without our squad leader? We had to help!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Oh, so scaredy-cat is squad leader? Well, well, look at you!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: That's just what Miss Guinaifen calls me... hehe.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Well, well, Tail actually does belong to Miss Huohuo!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Excuse me?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Despite Cirrus's scheming and calculating, they clearly didn't expect Tail to return to Huohuo... their plan to kidnap her was an utter failure. If they saw Huohuo as she is now, it would break their will!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Madam Hanya! Urgent news from Fyxestroll Garden! The subdued heliobi are stirring again!
rows.speaker: Spiritfarer Messenger

rows.text: ...Cirrus may not know the location of Tail, but they still figured out a way to divert everyone's attention.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: No wonder they like to use analogies such as "pawns" and "chess" to describe people. One momentary lapse of concentration, and suddenly we find ourselves backed into a corner.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: There's no need to blame yourself. This was Cirrus's plan all along.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Let's hurry back to Fyxestroll Garden now, while there's still a chance to turn things around. It's time to teach Cirrus a lesson.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: ...I concede.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Good.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I am no Ignamar... I'm nothing... nothing more than a faint flicker.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: I know of no "faint flicker" that could strategize such a fierce battle against one of the Reignbow Arbiter's generals.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Listening to a winner feign humility is enough to make one sick.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: The heliobi may reflect our desires, but their fervent blaze... is undeniably awe-inspiring. Neither General Teng Xiao nor myself would deride such a foe.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I have been bested, it's true... I only sought to lock horns with you, regardless of victory or defeat. Next...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Next is eternal punishment. For an inextinguishable flame such as yourself, I see no punishment more fitting than to see you confined to a vacant abyss, forever lamenting your past transgressions.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Such is the fate that awaits you, Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Hehe, so be it...
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Mountains will crumble, oceans will evaporate, but the heliobi will always be there, patiently waiting for their day of freedom... and that day will come.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: As long as the generals of the Xianzhou live, my battle against them will continue, until the stars themselves burn out.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: You're here. I've just finished re-inscribing the seal on Huohuo's tail. Next, it's time to address the matter of Cirrus.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I am freer than ever before... I am going nowhere.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tsk, let's see who takes care of who.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: ...Besides, when Mr. Tail isn't around, the other heliobi pick on me. I feel safer when Tail is here.
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Other heliobi? Hmph, I'm the only heliobus you need to worry about.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Well then, I will take care of the Cirrus situation. As for what gets written in the Luofu's Ghostly Grove, I'll leave that up to you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: One more thing, don't forget to seal the heliobi within the Evil Binding Matrix.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yes ma'am!
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Expel evil and capture stray spirits... With the support of the Ten-Lords Commission's spiritfarers, you seal the heliobus within the Lunaumbra Gourd.
I wrote to my mom about the recent monster-slaying and demon-fighting stuff I've been doing for the Ten-Lords Commission.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: What did you tell her?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I told her I went toe-to-toe with the swordfighting prodigy Yanqing and held my own against fragments of Ignamar. But all she did was scold me for getting into trouble! Do you think she was being sarcastic?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Now, let's think about what to publish on Ghostly Grove! This is huge news — this post will definitely boost our following.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Always on the hunt for more followers...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: It's called professionalism, alright?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I'm counting on you, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: The ghost-hunting squad can now rest easy for a while. Speaking as a judge of the Ten-Lords Commission, I must thank you all for the dedication you've shown these past few days. You really minimized the impact of the heliobi crisis.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: There may have been a few heliobi that slipped through the net, but they are of no major concern.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Leave them to us!
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: I don't wanna brag, but our articles on Ghostly Grove are the talk of the town! If we suddenly stopped uploading, it'd be pretty unfair to our audience.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Miss Gui...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Madam Hanya, p—please, let Little Gui carry on uploading... I can't fall asleep without browsing Ghostly Grove before bed...
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Hmm... You seem pretty set on this, so I won't stand in your way. However, bear in mind that—
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Don't worry, we promise not to make your job any harder than it already is.
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Wh—What?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: Don't look so surprised, young lady!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Surprised!? Huohuo has been worried sick trying to find you, and now something else has gone after her!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You flaming furball! What the heck is going on!? Did you know about this the whole time, Miss Hanya?
rows.speaker: Guinaifen

rows.text: As per our rules, any free-roaming heliobus must be sealed away. I was merely following protocol. Besides, it was Tail who requested this...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: It's a long story...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I only recall a moment during that fateful night when my consciousness was on the verge of shattering into a million pieces... time stood still.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I watched myself parting from Ignamar — drifting without purpose... Then, before I knew what had happened, the girl had retrieved me, and a judge of the Ten-Lords Commission had sealed me within a tail.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: I believe you humans call this kind of thing a "near-death-experience..." but why would a heliobus experience one of those? Ridiculous...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Since I'd slipped the leash, I thought I might as well change bodies and savor a bit of freedom. But then—
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Lucky for you, you met me.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: ...My luck took a sour turn when I ran into this demoness... I mean, judge.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: When I was with Huohuo, she'd constantly rant about me — whining about all the problems I'd caused her, how I'd ruined her life.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hehe, it was only after I vanished that she realized she'd taken my power for granted. I wanted to hear her cry about it, so in a fit of anger I had this demon— uh, judge imprison me in the gourd.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: You had had your wish. Now, I'm offering you a chance to regain your freedom... not by letting you go, but by going back to the way things were. Do we have a deal?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Can I trust you, Tail?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Of course! We're pretty much co-workers at this point!
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Hmm... So all I have to do is possess Huohuo and take out those other pesky heliobi... right?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: Tsk, tsk, if it isn't the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission — sluggish as ever.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Oh, and is that "Mr. Tail"? Back to being a guard dog I see — how delightful... This calls for a celebration!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Still, after our last encounter, I've no intention of including you in my plans. To see Ignamar's most powerful fragment now burdened with emotions pains me. It's a pity, but you've become expendable.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Who are you calling expendable!?
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission's matrix is still intact — the heliobi cannot leave Fyxestroll Garden. You may think you have the upper hand, but you're nothing more than a caged animal. You will never leave here.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Leave? That was never my plan. I came to Fyxestroll Garden for one reason, and one reason alone — to fight the Luofu's formidable general.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: He seemed fond of playing the waiting game — I merely capitalized on that. While you were all out on a wild goose chase, I rallied other heliobi to my cause, thereby increasing my strength!
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Thanks to all of you, I've amassed the power of every heliobus sealed within Fyxestroll Garden. All I need to do now is wait for the general to make his grand entrance.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Before that happens, I should keep my end of the bargain: Destroying you without leaving a trace.
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: They keep on coming back for more... What should we do, Tail?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Take it easy, kid. Heliobi might lack physical form, but they're not impervious to physical attacks. Cirrus is merely putting on a brave face.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: The moment they sense even a hint of defeat, it's over — they'll break into pieces, regardless of how powerful they are.
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: So just like what happened to Ignamar, once a heliobus realizes they're going to lose, they'll shatter?
rows.speaker: Huohuo

rows.text: Exactly. And If there's anyone who can cause Cirrus to shatter, it's him...
rows.speaker: Tail

rows.text: So, general, you've finally decided to show up. Ready to face the music?
rows.speaker: Cirrus

rows.text: Defeat my army, and I'll give you the rematch you seek. My word holds true.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As I mentioned previously, when Teng Xiao and Ignamar fought, the scales were balanced.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: But for you, Cirrus, this game was never about fairness, was it? And yet here we are — my power decidedly outmatches yours.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Notions of rules and equal competition are mere illusions. Now, if you don't mind, allow me to show you how the endgame is played.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan
